For decades, novels translated from other languages occupied a quiet corner of the book trade, accounting for barely 3 percent of fiction sales. That corner is getting crowded. New figures from the Bookscan Literary Index show that sales of translated fiction rose 28 percent last year, the fourth straight year of double-digit growth, with readers under 35 driving most of the increase. Booksellers point to several causes. Literary prizes have raised the visibility of translators, who now frequently appear on book covers alongside authors. Social media reading communities have championed novels from Korea, Japan, and Latin America, sometimes propelling decade-old titles onto bestseller lists. And a wave of small publishing houses devoted to translation has widened the selection available in bookstores. Dorothea Quint, who founded the translation-focused press Meridian Editions nine years ago, says the change is generational. "Younger readers simply do not regard a translated book as foreign," she said. "They follow stories, not borders." Major publishers are responding: at least three large houses have launched translation imprints in the past two years, and advances paid for translation rights have reportedly tripled for sought-after titles. Quint welcomes the competition, saying it benefits translators most of all.

They have lowered the prices of translated novels.
They have stopped paying advances to translators.
They have acquired Meridian Editions.
questions.explanation: 지문 후반에 '대형 출판사 최소 세 곳이 지난 2년 사이 번역 전문 임프린트를 출범시켰다'고 명시되어 있습니다. 번역서 전담 부문을 만들었다는 (A)가 정답입니다. 번역 판권 선인세는 오히려 세 배가 되었다고 보도됩니다.

passage: Pamper Your Pup at Whisker & Wag Grooming Salon! Located in the Brookfield Shopping Plaza, Whisker & Wag offers full-service grooming for dogs and cats of all breeds. Our certified groomers provide breed-standard haircuts, de-shedding treatments, nail trimming, and aromatherapy baths. Through June 30, first-time customers receive 20 percent off any full grooming package. Please note that the discount applies to full packages only; individual services such as nail trimming are excluded. Appointments are required for all grooming services, and a valid proof of rabies vaccination must be presented at check-in. Pets over 40 kilograms are subject to a $15 handling surcharge. We are open Tuesday through Saturday, 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M., and walk-in nail trims are accepted on Saturdays between 9:00 and 11:00 A.M. only. Book online at www.whiskerandwag.com or call 555-0182. Mention promotional code FRESHCUT when booking to claim your new-customer discount.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
options: To announce the relocation of a salon
To promote a pet grooming business
To recruit certified groomers
To advertise a veterinary clinic's vaccination program
questions.explanation: 광고 전반에서 Whisker & Wag Grooming Salon의 반려동물 미용 서비스(breed-standard haircuts, de-shedding treatments, nail trimming 등)를 소개하고 신규 고객 할인을 홍보하고 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 (B) '반려동물 미용 업체를 홍보하기 위해'입니다. 이전(relocation)이나 구인(recruit), 동물병원 예방접종 프로그램에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the 20 percent discount?
options: It is available to all returning customers.
It can be used for individual nail trimming services.
It expires at the end of June.
It requires a minimum purchase of two packages.
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Through June 30, first-time customers receive 20 percent off'라고 했으므로 할인은 6월 30일까지, 즉 6월 말에 종료됩니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 할인은 신규 고객(first-time customers) 대상이므로 (A)는 오답이고, 'individual services such as nail trimming are excluded'라고 했으므로 (B)도 오답이며, 최소 구매 조건은 언급되지 않았으므로 (D)도 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a requirement or condition at Whisker & Wag?
options: Showing proof of a vaccination
Paying an extra fee for very large pets
Making an appointment for grooming services
Leaving a deposit when booking online
questions.explanation: 지문에는 광견병 예방접종 증명서 제시('a valid proof of rabies vaccination must be presented'), 40kg 초과 반려동물에 대한 $15 추가 요금('a $15 handling surcharge'), 미용 서비스 예약 필수('Appointments are required')가 모두 언급되어 있습니다. 그러나 온라인 예약 시 보증금(deposit)에 대한 내용은 없으므로 정답은 (D)입니다.

questions.question: According to the advertisement, what can customers do on Saturday mornings?
options: Receive a nail trim without an appointment
Tour the grooming facility for free
Attend a pet care workshop
Get a complimentary aromatherapy bath
questions.explanation: 'walk-in nail trims are accepted on Saturdays between 9:00 and 11:00 A.M. only'라는 문장에서 토요일 오전 9시부터 11시 사이에는 예약 없이(walk-in) 발톱 손질을 받을 수 있다고 했습니다. 따라서 정답은 (A)입니다. 시설 견학, 워크숍, 무료 아로마테라피 목욕은 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage: www.cozypawsretreat.com/boarding --- Cozy Paws Retreat: Overnight Boarding. Give your dog a vacation while you take yours! Cozy Paws Retreat offers climate-controlled private suites, three daily exercise sessions, and twice-daily photo updates sent to your phone. Standard boarding is $48 per night, and our Deluxe Suite, which includes a webcam and an orthopedic bed, is $69 per night. Stays of seven nights or longer qualify for a 10 percent discount on the total boarding fee. Holiday periods (December 20 through January 3 and the last week of July) carry a $12-per-night peak-season surcharge, and reservations for those dates must be made at least 30 days in advance. All guests must be at least four months old, spayed or neutered if over one year of age, and current on vaccinations. Dogs that have not stayed with us before must pass a complimentary temperament evaluation, available Monday through Friday by appointment. Cancellations made fewer than 48 hours before check-in are charged one night's fee.

questions.question: What is included with a Deluxe Suite but not with standard boarding?
options: Daily exercise sessions
Photo updates
A webcam and an orthopedic bed
Climate-controlled accommodations
questions.explanation: Deluxe Suite에 대해 'which includes a webcam and an orthopedic bed'라고 설명하고 있으므로, 웹캠과 정형외과용(관절 보호) 침대가 디럭스 스위트에만 포함된 항목입니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 운동 세션, 사진 전송, 냉난방 시설은 모든 투숙견에게 제공되는 기본 서비스로 소개되어 있습니다.

questions.question: How can a customer qualify for a 10 percent discount?
options: By booking a stay of at least seven nights
By reserving 30 days in advance
By choosing a Deluxe Suite
By referring a new customer
questions.explanation: 'Stays of seven nights or longer qualify for a 10 percent discount on the total boarding fee'라고 명시되어 있으므로, 7박 이상 예약하면 총 요금의 10% 할인을 받을 수 있습니다. 정답은 (A)입니다. 30일 전 예약은 성수기 기간 예약의 필수 조건일 뿐 할인 조건이 아니며, 디럭스 스위트 선택이나 고객 추천에 따른 할인은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about dogs staying at Cozy Paws Retreat for the first time?
options: They must pay an additional evaluation fee.
They must be assessed before their stay.
They can only stay in standard suites.
They are not accepted during holiday periods.
questions.explanation: 'Dogs that have not stayed with us before must pass a complimentary temperament evaluation'이라고 했으므로, 처음 이용하는 개는 숙박 전에 기질 평가(temperament evaluation)를 통과해야 합니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 평가는 complimentary(무료)이므로 (A)는 오답이고, 스위트 제한이나 성수기 이용 불가에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: According to the webpage, when will a customer be charged a cancellation fee?
options: When canceling a holiday reservation at any time
When canceling less than 48 hours before check-in
When canceling a stay of seven nights or longer
When canceling a temperament evaluation appointment
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장 'Cancellations made fewer than 48 hours before check-in are charged one night's fee'에서 체크인 48시간 미만 전에 취소하면 1박 요금이 부과된다고 했습니다. 따라서 정답은 (B)입니다. 성수기 예약, 장기 숙박, 기질 평가 예약 취소에 대한 별도 수수료 규정은 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage: Brightline Tutoring Center — Helping Students Shine Since 2009. Is your child preparing for final exams or university entrance tests? Brightline's experienced instructors offer one-on-one and small-group tutoring in mathematics, science, English writing, and test preparation. All of our tutors hold university degrees in their subject areas and complete a 40-hour instructional training program before meeting their first student. This month only, enroll in any twelve-session package and receive two additional sessions at no charge. The offer ends May 31 and cannot be combined with our sibling discount. Sessions are available at our Maplewood Avenue location on weekdays from 3:00 to 9:00 P.M. and on Saturdays from 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. Online tutoring is also available for students in grades 9 through 12; however, our free diagnostic assessment, which identifies each student's strengths and weaknesses, is offered in person only. To schedule an assessment, call 555-0147 or visit www.brightlinetutoring.com.

questions.question: What is true about all Brightline tutors?
options: They have taught at the center since 2009.
They completed a training program before tutoring.
They specialize in university entrance interviews.
They are available seven days a week.
questions.explanation: 'All of our tutors ... complete a 40-hour instructional training program before meeting their first student'라고 했으므로, 모든 강사가 첫 수업 전에 40시간 교육 프로그램을 이수한다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 2009년은 센터 설립 연도일 뿐 모든 강사의 근속 기간이 아니며, 면접 전문이라는 언급도 없고, 수업은 평일과 토요일에만 제공되므로 (D)도 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the special offer?
options: It is valid only until the end of May.
It applies to any package of six sessions.
It can be combined with other discounts.
It is available exclusively to new students.
questions.explanation: 'The offer ends May 31'이라고 명시되어 있으므로 특별 혜택은 5월 31일, 즉 5월 말까지만 유효합니다. 정답은 (A)입니다. 혜택은 12회 패키지(twelve-session package) 등록 시 적용되므로 (B)는 오답이고, 'cannot be combined with our sibling discount'라고 했으므로 (C)도 오답이며, 신규 학생 전용이라는 조건은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a subject offered at Brightline?
options: Mathematics
English writing
Foreign languages
Science
questions.explanation: 지문에서 제공 과목으로 'mathematics, science, English writing, and test preparation'을 나열했습니다. 수학, 과학, 영작문은 모두 언급되었지만 외국어(foreign languages)는 언급되지 않았으므로 정답은 (C)입니다. NOT 문제는 지문에 언급된 항목을 하나씩 대조하여 소거하는 방식으로 풀어야 합니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the diagnostic assessment?
options: It costs a small fee for online students.
It cannot be completed remotely.
It takes 40 hours to complete.
It is required before enrolling in any package.
questions.explanation: 'our free diagnostic assessment ... is offered in person only'라고 했으므로 진단 평가는 대면으로만 제공되며 원격(온라인)으로는 받을 수 없습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 평가는 무료(free)이므로 (A)는 오답이고, 40시간은 강사 교육 프로그램의 길이이며, 패키지 등록 전 필수라는 언급은 없습니다.

passage: www.brightlinetutoring.com/careers --- Part-Time Mathematics Tutor (Maplewood Avenue Center). Brightline Tutoring Center is seeking two part-time mathematics tutors to join our growing team beginning in September. Responsibilities include leading one-on-one and small-group sessions for students in grades 7 through 12, preparing customized lesson materials, and writing brief monthly progress reports for parents. Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in mathematics, education, or a related field and have at least one year of teaching or tutoring experience. Experience with standardized test preparation is preferred but not required. Tutors work 12 to 18 hours per week, primarily on weekday evenings and Saturdays, and are paid $28 to $34 per hour depending on experience. Note that all successful candidates must pass a background check and complete our paid in-house training before their first session. To apply, e-mail a résumé, a cover letter, and the contact information for two references to careers@brightlinetutoring.com by July 15. Interviews will be conducted during the first week of August. Phone inquiries about this position will not be accepted.

questions.question: What is one responsibility of the advertised position?
options: Designing the center's annual budget
Writing monthly reports for parents
Supervising other tutors
Scheduling diagnostic assessments
questions.explanation: 직무 내용에 'writing brief monthly progress reports for parents'가 포함되어 있으므로, 학부모를 위한 월간 보고서 작성이 담당 업무 중 하나입니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 예산 수립, 다른 강사 감독, 진단 평가 일정 관리는 직무 설명에 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What qualification is required for the position?
options: A master's degree in mathematics
Three years of classroom teaching experience
At least one year of teaching or tutoring experience
Certification in standardized test preparation
questions.explanation: 'Applicants must ... have at least one year of teaching or tutoring experience'라고 명시했으므로 최소 1년의 교습 경력이 필수 요건입니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 학위는 학사(bachelor's degree)면 되므로 (A)는 오답이고, 시험 대비 경력은 'preferred but not required'(우대 사항)이므로 (D)도 오답입니다.

questions.question: What must successful candidates do before teaching their first session?
options: Complete unpaid weekend training
Pass a background check and finish training
Submit a sample lesson video
Obtain a teaching license
questions.explanation: 'all successful candidates must pass a background check and complete our paid in-house training before their first session'이라고 했으므로 첫 수업 전에 신원 조회 통과와 사내 교육 이수가 필요합니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 교육은 유급(paid)이므로 (A)는 오답이며, 샘플 영상 제출이나 교사 자격증 취득은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: How should interested applicants apply?
options: By calling the center's main office
By visiting the Maplewood Avenue location
By sending materials by e-mail
By completing an online application form
questions.explanation: 'To apply, e-mail a résumé, a cover letter, and the contact information for two references to careers@brightlinetutoring.com'이라고 안내했으므로 이메일로 지원 서류를 보내야 합니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 'Phone inquiries about this position will not be accepted'라고 했으므로 (A)는 명백한 오답이고, 방문 지원이나 온라인 지원서 작성은 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage: Spring Tune-Up Sale at Granger Cycle Works! From April 1 to April 21, Granger Cycle Works is offering its biggest savings of the year. All road and mountain bicycles from last season are marked down by up to 35 percent, and every helmet, light set, and lock in the store is 15 percent off. Purchase any bicycle priced over $500 during the sale and receive a free basic tune-up within the first year of ownership. Our certified mechanics can also upgrade your current ride: this month, labor charges for gear and brake adjustments are reduced to a flat $25. Please note that sale prices apply to in-stock items only and cannot be applied to special orders or previous purchases. Trade-ins are welcome — bring your old bicycle for an on-the-spot appraisal and put its value toward any new model. Granger Cycle Works, 312 Harbor Road, open daily 10:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. Find our full inventory at www.grangercycle.com.

questions.question: What is being advertised?
options: A grand opening celebration
A seasonal sale at a bicycle shop
A cycling competition
A new line of electric bicycles
questions.explanation: 광고 첫머리의 'Spring Tune-Up Sale'과 'From April 1 to April 21 ... biggest savings of the year'라는 표현에서 자전거 매장의 봄 할인 행사를 홍보하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 개업 기념행사, 자전거 대회, 전기 자전거 신제품 출시에 대한 내용은 없습니다.

questions.question: How can a customer receive a free tune-up?
options: By spending more than $500 on a bicycle
By trading in an old bicycle
By purchasing a helmet and a lock together
By signing up for the store's newsletter
questions.explanation: 'Purchase any bicycle priced over $500 during the sale and receive a free basic tune-up within the first year of ownership'라고 했으므로, 행사 기간에 $500가 넘는 자전거를 구매하면 무료 점검 서비스를 받을 수 있습니다. 정답은 (A)입니다. 보상 판매(trade-in)는 신차 구매 시 가격 차감 혜택일 뿐 무료 점검과는 무관합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the sale prices?
options: They apply to special orders.
They can be used on items bought in March.
They are limited to merchandise currently in stock.
They require a store membership.
questions.explanation: 'sale prices apply to in-stock items only and cannot be applied to special orders or previous purchases'라는 조건에서 할인가는 재고 보유 상품에만 적용된다는 것을 알 수 있습니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 특별 주문과 이전 구매(3월 구매 포함)에는 적용되지 않으므로 (A), (B)는 오답이고 멤버십 요건은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: The word "flat" in the advertisement is closest in meaning to
options: level
fixed
deflated
smooth
questions.explanation: 'labor charges ... are reduced to a flat $25'에서 flat은 '고정된, 일률적인' 요금을 의미합니다. 즉 작업 내용에 관계없이 일률적으로 $25만 받는다는 뜻이므로 'fixed(고정된)'가 가장 가까운 의미입니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. level(평평한), deflated(공기가 빠진), smooth(매끄러운)는 요금을 수식하는 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

passage: www.grangercycle.com/service --- Repair and Maintenance Services. Keep your bicycle running smoothly with Granger Cycle Works' professional service department. We offer three service levels. The Basic Tune-Up ($45) includes gear and brake adjustments, tire inflation, and a safety inspection. The Standard Overhaul ($95) adds wheel truing, chain replacement, and a full drivetrain cleaning. The Premium Rebuild ($180) covers complete disassembly, bearing replacement, and cable rewiring. Most Basic Tune-Ups are completed within 24 hours; Standard and Premium services typically require three to five business days. During March and April, our busiest months, please allow up to seven business days for all service levels. Customers who purchased their bicycle from Granger receive 10 percent off any service level at any time. Walk-in repairs of flat tires are handled while you wait, no appointment needed. Please note that we service bicycles only; we are unable to work on scooters, mopeds, or electric skateboards. Parts are covered by a six-month warranty, while labor is guaranteed for 30 days.

questions.question: What is included in the Standard Overhaul but not the Basic Tune-Up?
options: A safety inspection
Tire inflation
Chain replacement
Brake adjustments
questions.explanation: Standard Overhaul은 Basic Tune-Up의 내용에 'wheel truing, chain replacement, and a full drivetrain cleaning'을 추가(adds)한다고 했으므로, 체인 교체는 Standard에만 포함됩니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 안전 점검, 타이어 공기 주입, 브레이크 조정은 모두 Basic Tune-Up($45)에 포함된 항목입니다.

questions.question: According to the webpage, why might a repair take longer in April?
options: The shop is closed for renovations.
It is one of the shop's busiest periods.
Replacement parts are difficult to obtain.
The shop operates with reduced staff.
questions.explanation: 'During March and April, our busiest months, please allow up to seven business days for all service levels'라고 했으므로 3~4월은 가장 바쁜 시기여서 수리 기간이 길어질 수 있습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 매장 보수공사, 부품 수급 문제, 인력 부족은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is NOT a service that Granger Cycle Works provides?
options: Repairing electric skateboards
Fixing flat tires for walk-in customers
Replacing bearings
Cleaning drivetrains
questions.explanation: 'we are unable to work on scooters, mopeds, or electric skateboards'라고 명시했으므로 전동 스케이트보드 수리는 제공하지 않는 서비스입니다. 정답은 (A)입니다. 펑크 수리는 예약 없이 대기 중 처리되고(walk-in repairs of flat tires), 베어링 교체는 Premium Rebuild에, 구동계 세척은 Standard Overhaul에 포함되어 있습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the shop's warranty policy?
options: Labor is guaranteed for six months.
Parts and labor have different coverage periods.
Warranties apply only to Premium Rebuilds.
Customers must register online to activate coverage.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장 'Parts are covered by a six-month warranty, while labor is guaranteed for 30 days'에서 부품은 6개월, 공임은 30일로 보증 기간이 서로 다르다는 것을 알 수 있습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 공임 보증은 30일이므로 (A)는 오답이고, 보증이 특정 서비스에만 적용된다거나 온라인 등록이 필요하다는 내용은 없습니다.

passage: Crisp & Clean Dry Cleaners — Now Two Locations to Serve You! Visit us at 88 Telford Street downtown or at our brand-new branch inside the Eastgate Mall. Bring in this advertisement to receive $10 off any order of $40 or more. The coupon is valid through August 15 at both locations and is limited to one per customer per visit. Please note that the discount does not apply to leather garments, wedding gowns, or household items such as curtains and comforters, which are priced separately. We offer same-day service at no extra charge for garments dropped off before 9:00 A.M. on weekdays; items received after that time will be ready the following business day. Our free mobile app lets you schedule pickup and delivery within five kilometers of either location for orders of $25 or more. All cleaning is performed on-site using environmentally friendly, perchloroethylene-free solvents that are gentle on fabrics and safe for sensitive skin.

questions.question: What is suggested about Crisp & Clean Dry Cleaners?
options: It recently opened a second location.
It has been in business for over a decade.
It is closed on weekends.
It sends garments to an off-site facility.

passage: www.harmonyhousemusic.com/enroll --- Enrollment Information. CITY OF RIVERTON — DEPARTMENT OF BUILDINGS

NOTICE TO PERMIT APPLICANTS

Effective July 1, all applications for residential construction permits must be submitted through the city's online portal at riverton.gov/permits. Paper applications will be accepted only by appointment at the City Hall service counter, Room 204. Standard application review takes fifteen business days. Applicants who require faster processing may request expedited review, which is completed within five business days for an additional charge of $150.

Permit fees are calculated at $0.45 per square foot of proposed construction, with a minimum fee of $90. Fees must be paid in full before a permit is issued. Each permit remains valid for 180 days from the date of issuance. A single 90-day extension may be granted if a written request is received before the permit expires; the extension fee is $40.

To report a change in branch opening hours
To explain a security breach
questions.explanation: 공지의 첫 문단에서 9월 1일부터 우편 종이 명세서를 받는 계좌에 월 $2.00 수수료가 부과된다고 안내하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 신규 상품 소개, 영업시간 변경, 보안 사고는 본문에 등장하지 않습니다.

questions.question: How much would a customer pay in paper statement fees over one full year?
questions.explanation: 종이 명세서 수수료는 월 $2.00이므로 1년(12개월) 동안 부과되는 총액은 $2 × 12 = $24입니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 월 수수료를 연 단위로 환산하는 간단한 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: Who will NOT be charged the fee even without changing their preferences?
options: Customers who opened their account this year
Customers aged 65 or older
Customers with more than one account
Customers who visit a branch monthly
questions.explanation: 본문에 만 65세 이상 계좌 보유자와 Premium Advantage 계좌 보유자는 수수료가 자동 면제되며 별도 조치가 필요 없다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 신규 고객, 복수 계좌 보유자, 지점 방문 고객에 대한 면제 규정은 없습니다.

questions.question: What additional benefit is offered to customers who enroll by August 25?
options: A higher interest rate
A waiver of all banking fees
Entry into a gift card drawing
A free safe-deposit box
questions.explanation: 8월 25일까지 전자 명세서로 전환하는 고객은 $100 상품권 10장 중 하나를 받을 수 있는 추첨에 응모된다고 안내되어 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 금리 인상, 전체 수수료 면제, 무료 대여금고는 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage:
Hartwell Savings Bank
140 Commerce Street, Dalton

June 5

Dear Mr. Reuben Tate,

Our records show that your savings account ending in 4471 has had no deposits, withdrawals, or customer-initiated activity for the past twenty-two months. Under state regulations, an account with no activity for twenty-four consecutive months must be classified as dormant. Dormant accounts are charged a $5.00 monthly maintenance fee, and online access to them is suspended until the account holder visits a branch in person.

Furthermore, if an account remains dormant for an additional twelve months, the bank is required by law to transfer the balance to the state unclaimed property office, after which all claims must be filed with that office rather than with the bank.

Keeping your account active is simple: make a deposit or withdrawal of any amount, or sign in to online banking, by August 15. Any one of these actions will reset the activity record. If you no longer need the account, you may close it at any branch free of charge.

Sincerely,
Priya Raman
Customer Accounts Manager

questions.question: Why did Ms. Raman write the letter?
options: To warn a customer that his account may become dormant
To confirm that an account has been closed
To offer a customer a loan with a low interest rate
To request repayment of an overdrawn balance
questions.explanation: 편지의 목적은 22개월간 거래가 없는 계좌가 24개월이 되면 휴면(dormant) 계좌로 분류된다는 사실을 알리고, 8월 15일까지 거래를 하여 이를 방지하도록 안내하는 것입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 계좌 해지 확인, 대출 제안, 마이너스 잔액 상환 요청은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the letter, what happens when an account is classified as dormant?
options: The account is immediately closed.
A monthly fee is charged and online access is suspended.
The interest rate is reduced to zero.
The balance is donated to charity.
questions.explanation: 휴면 계좌로 분류되면 월 $5.00의 관리 수수료가 부과되고, 계좌 소유자가 지점을 직접 방문할 때까지 온라인 접근이 정지된다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 즉시 해지되거나 잔액이 기부되는 것이 아니며, 금리에 대한 언급도 없습니다.

questions.question: How can Mr. Tate prevent his account from becoming dormant?
options: By writing a letter to the state office
By paying a $5.00 reactivation fee
By making any transaction or logging in by August 15
By opening a second account at the bank
questions.explanation: 편지 후반부에서 8월 15일까지 금액에 상관없이 입금 또는 출금을 하거나 온라인 뱅킹에 로그인하면 활동 기록이 갱신되어 휴면 처리를 막을 수 있다고 안내하고 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 주 정부 기관에 편지를 쓰거나 수수료를 내는 방법은 제시되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What can be inferred about funds transferred to the state unclaimed property office?
options: They can no longer be recovered by the owner.
They must be claimed through the state office, not the bank.
They are returned to the bank after one year.
They earn a higher interest rate.
questions.explanation: 잔액이 주 미수령 재산 관리소(state unclaimed property office)로 이관된 후에는 모든 청구를 은행이 아닌 해당 기관에 제기해야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 즉 돈을 영영 찾을 수 없는 것이 아니라 청구 창구가 바뀌는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
GLENFIELD POST OFFICE — SERVICE CHANGES

Please note the following changes, which take effect Monday, October 6.

Postage rates: The price of a standard first-class stamp will increase from $0.68 to $0.73. The rate for postcards will rise from $0.53 to $0.56. Customers may purchase stamps at current prices until October 5; stamps marked FOREVER remain valid regardless of future rate changes.

Collection times: The final weekday mail collection from the lobby boxes will move from 6:00 P.M. to 5:30 P.M. Saturday collection remains at noon.

Window hours: Saturday counter service will be shortened to 9:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M. Weekday hours are unchanged.

Passport services: Beginning October 6, passport applications will be accepted by appointment only. Appointments can be booked at glenfieldpost.gov/passport or by calling 555-0119.

We appreciate your understanding as we adjust our services to current mail volumes.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce the permanent closure of a post office
To describe several upcoming service changes
To recruit seasonal postal workers
To apologize for a delayed shipment
questions.explanation: 공지는 10월 6일부터 적용되는 우편 요금 인상, 수거 시간 변경, 토요일 창구 시간 단축, 여권 업무 예약제 전환 등 여러 가지 서비스 변경 사항을 안내하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 우체국 폐쇄, 직원 채용, 배송 지연 사과는 본문 내용과 무관합니다.

questions.question: How much more will 20 first-class stamps cost at the new rate than at the current rate?
questions.explanation: 일반 1종 우표 가격이 $0.68에서 $0.73로 인상되어 장당 $0.05 오릅니다. 20장 기준 인상분은 $0.05 × 20 = $1.00이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. (A)는 1장 기준 인상분, (D)는 새 요금 20장 가격($14.60)과 헷갈리도록 만든 함정과 무관한 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about FOREVER stamps?
options: They will be discontinued on October 6.
They remain valid even after rates change.
They can be used only for postcards.
They must be exchanged for new stamps.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 FOREVER 표시가 있는 우표는 향후 요금 변경과 관계없이 계속 유효하다고 명시하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 단종, 엽서 전용, 교환 의무에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: According to the notice, what will customers need to do to apply for a passport after October 6?
options: Visit on a Saturday morning
Make an appointment in advance
Pay an additional service fee
Submit applications by mail only
questions.explanation: 10월 6일부터 여권 신청은 예약제(by appointment only)로만 접수되며, 웹사이트나 전화로 예약할 수 있다고 안내되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 토요일 방문, 추가 수수료, 우편 접수에 대한 요구 사항은 본문에 없습니다.

passage:
Glenfield Post Office
2 Station Road, Glenfield

July 10

Dear Box Holder,

Our records indicate that the six-month rental period for Post Office Box 412 will end on July 31. To keep your box without interruption, please renew by July 24. Renewals received between July 25 and July 31 will be processed with a $10 late-handling charge. If no renewal is received by August 10, the box will be closed, the lock will be reset, and any mail addressed to the box will be returned to senders.

Renewal options are as follows: six months for $56 or twelve months for $102. Payment may be made online at glenfieldpost.gov/boxes, at the retail counter during business hours, or by check mailed to the address above. Please write your box number on all payments.

Customers who renew for twelve months will also receive two months of free package alerts by text message.

Thank you for using our box rental service.

Carl Jensen
Retail Services Supervisor

questions.question: Why was the letter sent?
options: To inform a customer that a package has arrived
To remind a customer to renew a post office box rental
To announce an increase in box rental prices
To notify a customer of a change of address
questions.explanation: 편지는 사서함 412호의 6개월 임대 기간이 7월 31일에 종료되므로 7월 24일까지 갱신할 것을 안내하는 갱신 독려 편지입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 소포 도착 통지, 요금 인상 발표, 주소 변경 통보가 목적이 아닙니다.

questions.question: How much would a customer save by choosing one twelve-month renewal instead of two six-month renewals?
questions.explanation: 6개월 갱신은 $56이므로 두 번 갱신하면 $56 × 2 = $112입니다. 12개월 갱신은 $102이므로 절약액은 $112 − $102 = $10입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 두 요금제를 비교하여 차액을 구하는 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What will happen if no renewal is received by August 10?
options: The rental fee will be doubled.
The box will be closed and mail returned to senders.
The mail will be forwarded to the customer's home.
The box will be assigned a new number.
questions.explanation: 8월 10일까지 갱신이 접수되지 않으면 사서함이 폐쇄되고 자물쇠가 재설정되며, 해당 사서함으로 온 우편물은 발신인에게 반송된다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 요금 두 배 부과, 자택 전송, 번호 변경은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What extra benefit is offered with a twelve-month renewal?
options: A discount on postage stamps
A free replacement key
Two months of free text message package alerts
Priority counter service
questions.explanation: 편지 후반부에 12개월 갱신 고객에게는 문자 메시지 소포 알림 서비스 2개월 무료 혜택이 제공된다고 안내되어 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 우표 할인, 무료 열쇠 교체, 창구 우선 서비스는 본문에 없습니다.

passage:
BAYPORT–CEDAR ISLAND FERRY
SUMMER SCHEDULE (June 15 – September 7)

Departures from Bayport Pier: 7:00 A.M., 9:30 A.M., 12:00 noon, 2:30 P.M., 5:00 P.M., 7:30 P.M.

The crossing takes 40 minutes. Each ferry departs Cedar Island for the return trip 45 minutes after its arrival there.

Fares: Adults $9 one way, $16 round trip. Children under 12 travel at half the adult one-way fare. Bicycles may be brought aboard for an additional $3 each. Passengers traveling with vehicles must reserve space at least 24 hours in advance at bayportferry.com, as vehicle capacity is limited to twelve cars per crossing.

Notes: Boarding closes five minutes before departure. The 7:30 P.M. sailing does not operate on Sundays. In the event of severe weather, cancellations are posted on the website by 6:00 A.M. Ticket holders on canceled sailings may rebook free of charge or request a full refund within 30 days.

questions.question: What time does the 2:30 P.M. ferry arrive at Cedar Island?
questions.explanation: 운항 시간이 40분이므로 오후 2시 30분에 출발한 페리는 2:30 + 40분 = 오후 3시 10분에 시더 아일랜드에 도착합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 출발 시각에 소요 시간을 더하는 시간 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much does an adult save by buying a round-trip ticket instead of two one-way tickets?
questions.explanation: 성인 편도 요금은 $9이므로 편도 두 번이면 $18입니다. 왕복 요금은 $16이므로 절약액은 $18 − $16 = $2입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. (C) $3은 자전거 추가 요금과 혼동을 유도하는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What must passengers traveling with a vehicle do?
options: Arrive one hour before departure
Pay double the adult fare
Reserve space at least 24 hours in advance
Travel only on weekday sailings
questions.explanation: 차량 동반 승객은 회당 차량 수용이 12대로 제한되어 있으므로 최소 24시간 전에 웹사이트에서 자리를 예약해야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 1시간 전 도착, 요금 2배, 평일 한정 탑승 조건은 본문에 없습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about canceled sailings?
options: They are announced on the website by 6:00 A.M.
They are rescheduled to the following Sunday.
Tickets for them lose all value.
They occur only in winter.
questions.explanation: 악천후로 인한 결항은 오전 6시까지 웹사이트에 게시되며, 결항 편 승객은 무료 재예약 또는 30일 이내 전액 환불이 가능하다고 안내되어 있습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 표가 무효가 된다는 (C)는 본문 내용과 반대됩니다.

passage:
BAYPORT–CEDAR ISLAND FERRY — SERVICE NOTICE

Posted October 20

The MV Harbor Star will be withdrawn from service from Monday, November 3, through Friday, November 14, for scheduled engine maintenance. During this period, the smaller vessel MV Gull will operate a reduced timetable of four daily crossings: 8:00 A.M., 11:00 A.M., 2:00 P.M., and 5:00 P.M. from Bayport.

Please note that the MV Gull carries foot passengers and bicycles only; it has no vehicle deck. Customers who need to take a car to Cedar Island during the maintenance period are advised to use the Route 9 bridge, approximately 30 kilometers north of Bayport.

Passengers holding vehicle reservations for the affected dates will be contacted by e-mail and may transfer their booking to another date or receive a full refund. Foot passenger tickets remain valid on the MV Gull without any change.

Normal service with the MV Harbor Star is expected to resume on Saturday, November 15. We apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a temporary change in ferry service
To advertise discounted ferry fares
To introduce a newly built vessel
To report an accident at the pier
questions.explanation: 공지는 MV Harbor Star호가 엔진 정비를 위해 11월 3일부터 14일까지 운항을 중단하고, 그동안 대체 선박이 축소 운항한다는 일시적 서비스 변경을 알리는 것이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 할인 요금, 신규 선박 도입, 사고 보고는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is NOT possible on the MV Gull?
options: Traveling with a bicycle
Traveling as a foot passenger
Transporting a car
Using an existing foot passenger ticket
questions.explanation: MV Gull호는 도보 승객과 자전거만 수송할 수 있고 차량 갑판이 없다고 명시되어 있으므로, 자동차 수송이 불가능합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 자전거 동반, 도보 승객 탑승, 기존 도보 승객 표 사용은 모두 가능합니다.

questions.question: What alternative is suggested for drivers during the maintenance period?
options: Taking an earlier ferry crossing
Using the Route 9 bridge
Renting a car on Cedar Island
Waiting until November 15
questions.explanation: 정비 기간 중 차량으로 시더 아일랜드에 가야 하는 고객에게는 베이포트에서 북쪽으로 약 30킬로미터 떨어진 Route 9 다리를 이용하라고 권고하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 다른 선택지는 본문에서 제안된 대안이 아닙니다.

questions.question: How long will the MV Harbor Star be out of service?
options: About one week
About twelve days
About one month
About three days
questions.explanation: 운항 중단 기간은 11월 3일 월요일부터 11월 14일 금요일까지로, 두 날짜를 포함하면 총 12일입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 시작일과 종료일을 바탕으로 기간을 계산하는 날짜 산술 문제입니다.

passage:
MAPLEWOOD TERRACE HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION

NOTICE OF ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING

All residents are invited to the annual general meeting on Tuesday, October 12, at 7:00 P.M. in the clubhouse. The agenda includes the annual budget review, election of two board members, a report on landscaping contracts, and a vote on the revised parking policy described below. Light refreshments will be served from 6:30 P.M.

Owners who cannot attend may vote by proxy. Proxy forms are available at the management office and must be returned no later than Friday, October 8.

Proposed parking policy (effective November 1 if approved): Guest vehicles parked in the community for more than 48 consecutive hours will require a guest permit displayed on the dashboard. Each unit may request up to two guest permits per month at no charge from the management office. Vehicles without a permit after the 48-hour limit may be towed at the owner's expense. Resident vehicles with valid stickers are not affected by this change.

questions.question: What is one purpose of the notice?
options: To invite residents to an annual meeting
To announce the sale of the clubhouse
To request payment of overdue fees
To advertise units available for rent
questions.explanation: 공지는 10월 12일 화요일 오후 7시에 클럽하우스에서 열리는 연례 총회에 모든 주민을 초대하고 안건을 안내하는 것이 핵심 목적이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 클럽하우스 매각, 연체료 납부 요청, 임대 광고는 본문에 없습니다.

questions.question: By when must proxy forms be returned?
options: October 8
October 12
November 1
October 31
questions.explanation: 총회에 참석할 수 없는 소유주는 위임장(proxy)으로 투표할 수 있으며, 위임장 양식은 늦어도 10월 8일 금요일까지 제출해야 한다고 명시되어 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 10월 12일은 총회 날짜, 11월 1일은 주차 정책 시행 예정일입니다.

questions.question: According to the proposed policy, when would a guest vehicle need a permit?
options: Immediately upon arrival
After being parked for more than 48 hours
Only on weekends
After receiving two warnings
questions.explanation: 제안된 주차 정책에 따르면 48시간을 연속으로 초과하여 주차된 방문객 차량은 대시보드에 방문객 허가증을 비치해야 합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 도착 즉시, 주말 한정, 경고 2회 후라는 조건은 본문에 없습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about resident vehicles?
options: They must be re-registered every month.
They are limited to two per unit.
Those with valid stickers are not affected by the change.
They must park outside the community.
questions.explanation: 공지 마지막 문장에서 유효한 스티커를 부착한 입주민 차량은 이번 정책 변경의 영향을 받지 않는다고 명시하고 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 매월 재등록, 세대당 2대 제한(이는 방문객 허가증 수량), 단지 외부 주차 의무는 사실과 다릅니다.

passage:
Maplewood Terrace Homeowners Association
Management Office, Building C

February 10

Dear Homeowner,

At its January meeting, the board approved the full replacement of the roofs on Buildings A and B, which inspectors found to be at the end of their service life. The total contracted cost is $180,000. The association's reserve fund will cover $120,000 of this amount. The remaining $60,000 will be collected through a one-time special assessment divided equally among all 120 units.

Accordingly, each unit owner is responsible for a special assessment of $500. Payment may be made in a single payment due by March 31, or in five monthly installments of $100 each, beginning March 1. COMMERCE BOULEVARD RESURFACING

To minimize disruption to daytime traffic, Commerce Boulevard between First Street and Ninth Street will be resurfaced at night. Work is scheduled nightly from 9:00 P.M. to 5:00 A.M., beginning Monday, September 8, and ending Friday, September 12.

All analytical balances in Rooms 210, 214, and 218 must be calibrated on the first working day of each month. Operators assigned to calibration duty should follow the steps below in order.

METRO TRANSIT AUTHORITY — LOST AND FOUND POLICY

Items found on buses, trains, or station property are sent to the central Lost and Found office at 75 Terminal Plaza, Lower Level.

Holding periods: Most items are held for 60 days from the date they are received. Wallets, identification cards, and passports are held for 30 days, after which identification documents are forwarded to the agencies that issued them. Perishable items, including food and beverages, are discarded within 24 hours for health reasons.

Claiming an item: Owners must claim items in person on weekdays between 8:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M. To claim an item, you must describe it in reasonable detail and present a photo ID. A claim inquiry may be started online at metrotransit.gov/lostfound, but items are never mailed or released to third parties without a signed authorization letter.

Unclaimed items: At the end of the holding period, unclaimed items of value are sold at public auction, and the proceeds support the authority's reduced-fare program. Other items are donated to local charities.

The Metro Transit Authority is not responsible for items lost on its vehicles or property.

Last quarter, 2,150 subscribers completed our annual readership survey. Key findings:

LOGISTICS MONTHLY — Industry Outlook
"Smaller Warehouses, Faster Cities" by Han Bekele
A growing number of retailers are abandoning the traditional model of one giant distribution center per region. Instead, they are leasing networks of small urban warehouses, often under 2,000 square meters, located within city limits. Proponents say these "micro-hubs" cut average delivery times from two days to under five hours and reduce fuel use because delivery vans travel shorter distances—some operators even use cargo bicycles for the final kilometer. Critics counter that urban rents make micro-hubs three to four times more expensive per square meter and that finding suitable buildings is difficult. Nevertheless, our survey of 80 logistics firms found that 62 percent plan to open at least one micro-hub within two years.

--- Passage 2 ---
Letters to the Editor
Dear Logistics Monthly,
I read Mr. Bekele's article on micro-hubs with great interest, but I believe it overlooked a key obstacle. My company operates three urban warehouses in Selton, and our biggest challenge has never been rent—it is the shortage of overnight loading zones. City regulations prohibit trucks from restocking our hubs between 7 A.M. and 8 P.M., yet residential noise rules also restrict deliveries after 10 P.M. That leaves a very narrow window. Until municipal governments modernize these rules, the five-hour delivery promise mentioned in the article will be hard to keep. I would welcome a follow-up piece on how cities abroad have solved this.
Grace Okonjo, Operations Director, Selton Express

MEMO

To: All Consultants and Analysts
From: Geraldine Mosely, Director of Operations
Date: April 16
Subject: Transition to the TrackWise Timesheet System

Beginning Monday, May 5, Brockton Consulting Group will replace its current paper-based timesheet process with TrackWise, a cloud-based time-tracking platform. This change follows repeated feedback from project managers, who reported that late or incomplete timesheets delayed client invoicing by an average of six business days last quarter.

Under the new system, all billable and non-billable hours must be entered daily rather than at the end of each week. TrackWise automatically assigns hours to the correct client account using the project codes you already use, so no new codes need to be memorized. The platform can be accessed from your laptop or through a mobile application.

Mandatory training sessions will be held in Conference Room B on April 28 and 29 at 10:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M. each day. You need to attend only one session. Sign up through the link on the staff intranet by April 24. Anyone with a scheduling conflict should contact their team leader to arrange an individual session.

Paper timesheets will not be accepted after May 2.

The current process has been delaying billing.
The paper supplier raised its prices.
A government regulation requires electronic records.

To address the rising volume of water and soil samples — up 35 percent since we won the county stormwater contract in March — the laboratory is changing its sample intake procedures effective Monday, August 4.

Pre-registration generates a barcode label that field crews should print at the office or request from the lab the day before collection. Samples arriving without barcodes will still be accepted through September 1, with a grace-period sticker, but after that date unregistered samples will be logged manually at a charge of $15 per sample to the submitting project's budget.

Second, the intake window will change. The current arrangement, under which samples are accepted whenever staff are present, will be replaced by set receiving hours: 7:00-11:00 A.M. and 1:00-4:00 P.M. on weekdays. Time-sensitive samples — those with holding times under 24 hours, such as bacteria samples — will continue to be accepted at any hour through the after-hours refrigerator by the loading dock; place them inside, log them on the clipboard, and send a text alert to the on-duty technician at the number posted on the door.

Third, chain-of-custody forms now require the collector's LabFlow ID rather than a handwritten name, eliminating the lookup delays that caused several reporting errors in May.

A fifteen-minute demonstration of the pre-registration screen will be given at the July 21 and July 28 staff meetings. Slides will be posted afterward for anyone who misses both.

Hannah Cole (2:04 P.M.): Out of service? The event resumes at 3 P.M. sharp after the keynote.
Tomás Rivera (2:05 P.M.): Building maintenance says forty-five minutes at least. The passenger elevators are too small for the carts.
Greg Fontaine (2:07 P.M.): Could we unload the carts and carry trays up by hand? It's only the fourth floor.
Hannah Cole (2:08 P.M.): With six carts? We'd need every pair of hands we have.
Tomás Rivera (2:10 P.M.): The servers are still resetting the tables. I can spare two people at most.
Greg Fontaine (2:11 P.M.): I'm parking the second van now. Give me five minutes and you'll have three more.
Hannah Cole (2:13 P.M.): Do it. Tomás, prioritize the chilled items—the mousse cups can't sit in the loading dock.
Tomás Rivera (2:14 P.M.): Understood. We'll run the stairwell relay and have everything plated by 2:50.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Rivera report?
options: A keynote speech has been canceled.
Some dessert items were left at the kitchen.
A freight elevator cannot be used.
A delivery van has not arrived.
questions.explanation: 2시 2분 메시지에서 Mr. Rivera는 "The freight elevator is out of service"라고 하며 화물 엘리베이터가 고장 나 디저트 카트 여섯 대가 아래층에 있다고 보고합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 기조연설 취소나 밴 미도착 문제는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: At 2:08 P.M., what does Ms. Cole most likely mean when she writes, "With six carts?"?
options: She doubts the team has enough people for the plan.
She thinks fewer carts should have been ordered.
She believes six carts will fit in the passenger elevator.
She wants to know where the carts are stored.
questions.explanation: Mr. Fontaine이 카트에서 짐을 내려 손으로 트레이를 옮기자고 제안하자, Ms. Cole은 "With six carts? We'd need every pair of hands we have."라고 답합니다. 카트 여섯 대 분량을 손으로 옮기려면 모든 인력이 필요하다는 뜻으로, 인력이 충분할지 의문을 표하는 것입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Fontaine offer to do?
options: Repair the freight elevator
Provide three additional helpers shortly
Postpone the dessert service until 4 P.M.
Move the mousse cups into a refrigerator
questions.explanation: 2시 11분에 Mr. Fontaine은 두 번째 밴을 주차하는 중이며 5분만 주면 세 명을 더 보내 주겠다("Give me five minutes and you'll have three more")고 제안합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 엘리베이터 수리, 서비스 연기, 냉장 보관은 그의 제안이 아닙니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the chilled desserts?
options: They were damaged during transport.
They will be served during the keynote.
They should be moved before the other items.
They are stored on the fourth floor.
questions.explanation: 2시 13분에 Ms. Cole이 "prioritize the chilled items—the mousse cups can't sit in the loading dock"이라고 지시합니다. 즉, 차가운 디저트류를 다른 품목보다 먼저 옮겨야 한다는 의미이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 디저트가 파손되었다거나 4층에 보관 중이라는 내용은 없습니다.

passage:
Vera Lindqvist (7:31 A.M.): Moving day, everyone! Movers from Brightway Relocation arrive at our old office at 8 A.M. Please confirm your floor assignments.
Sam Okafor (7:33 A.M.): I'm covering the third floor. All the marketing department's crates are labeled and sealed.
Julia Pratt (7:34 A.M.): Second floor here. One issue—the design team left two monitors unpacked on their desks.
Vera Lindqvist (7:36 A.M.): They were told everything had to be in crates by Friday.
Julia Pratt (7:37 A.M.): I know. Should I find boxes for them, or do the monitors stay behind?
Vera Lindqvist (7:39 A.M.): There should be padded electronics boxes left over in the supply room on your floor. Use those.
Sam Okafor (7:41 A.M.): Heads-up: the loading dock at the new building on Carver Street is shared with two other tenants. We only have it booked from 9 to 12.
Vera Lindqvist (7:42 A.M.): Right, which is why the trucks must leave here by 8:45. Julia, can you make that?
Julia Pratt (7:44 A.M.): If the boxes are where you say they are, no problem.
Vera Lindqvist (7:45 A.M.): They are. I put them there myself on Thursday.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the message chain?
options: To coordinate tasks on an office relocation day
To order new monitors for the design team
To complain about a moving company's fees
To schedule a tour of a building on Carver Street
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 Ms. Lindqvist가 "Moving day, everyone!"이라며 이사 업체 도착 시간과 층별 담당을 확인하고, 이후 포장 문제와 트럭 출발 시간 등을 조율합니다. 사무실 이전 당일의 업무를 조율하는 대화이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Pratt mention?
options: The movers have arrived earlier than expected.
Some equipment has not been packed.
A supply room is locked.
Several crates are missing labels.
questions.explanation: 7시 34분에 Ms. Pratt은 디자인 팀이 모니터 두 대를 포장하지 않은 채 책상에 두고 갔다("left two monitors unpacked on their desks")고 보고합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 이사 업체의 조기 도착, 잠긴 비품실, 라벨 누락은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: Why must the trucks leave by 8:45 A.M.?
options: The movers charge extra after 9 A.M.
A street will be closed to traffic at noon.
The loading dock reservation is limited to certain hours.
The old building must be vacated by 9 A.M.
questions.explanation: 7시 41분에 Mr. Okafor가 새 건물의 하역장은 다른 입주사 둘과 공유하며 9시부터 12시까지만 예약되어 있다고 알리자, Ms. Lindqvist가 "which is why the trucks must leave here by 8:45"라고 답합니다. 하역장 예약 시간이 제한되어 있기 때문이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 7:45 A.M., what does Ms. Lindqvist most likely mean when she writes, "I put them there myself on Thursday"?
options: She is certain the packing boxes are available.
She moved the monitors to the new office already.
She thinks Ms. Pratt should have packed earlier.
She wants the supply room reorganized.
questions.explanation: Ms. Pratt이 "If the boxes are where you say they are, no problem"이라고 조건을 달자, Ms. Lindqvist는 자신이 목요일에 직접 상자를 가져다 두었다고 답합니다. 이는 상자가 그 자리에 확실히 있으니 걱정하지 말라는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Noah Berger (10:05 A.M.): Status check, everyone. The server racks are on the truck, but I can't find the box with the network cables.
Fatima El-Sayed (10:07 A.M.): It should be in the cage with the rest of the IT equipment. Blue tape, labeled NET-04.
Noah Berger (10:09 A.M.): The cage has NET-01 through NET-03. No NET-04.
Lena Wojcik (10:11 A.M.): Check the reception desk. Facilities was using that box to prop the door open this morning.
Noah Berger (10:13 A.M.): Unbelievable. Found it. Loading it now.
Fatima El-Sayed (10:14 A.M.): Good. Remember, IT goes on the first truck. We need the network up at the new place before anyone else unpacks.
Lena Wojcik (10:16 A.M.): Speaking of which, the internet provider confirmed a technician for 1 P.M. at the new office. Someone has to be there to let them in.
Fatima El-Sayed (10:17 A.M.): I'll head over at noon. Noah, ride with the first truck and start racking the servers when you arrive.
Noah Berger (10:19 A.M.): Got it. Truck should roll out within twenty minutes.

questions.question: What was Mr. Berger initially unable to locate?
options: A truck driver
A container of cables
A list of floor assignments
A set of server racks
questions.explanation: 10시 5분 메시지에서 Mr. Berger는 "I can't find the box with the network cables"라고 하며 네트워크 케이블 상자를 찾지 못하고 있다고 말합니다. 서버 랙은 이미 트럭에 실려 있다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 10:13 A.M., what does Mr. Berger most likely mean when he writes, "Unbelievable"?
options: He is amazed by how quickly the trucks were loaded.
He cannot believe the technician is arriving at 1 P.M.
He is annoyed about how the box was being used.
He doubts that the box is labeled correctly.
questions.explanation: Ms. Wojcik이 시설팀이 그 상자를 문 고정용으로 쓰고 있었다고 알려 주자, Mr. Berger는 "Unbelievable. Found it."이라고 답합니다. 중요한 장비 상자가 문 받침대로 쓰이고 있었다는 사실에 어이없어하는(짜증 섞인) 반응이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why should the IT equipment be transported first?
options: It is the heaviest cargo to load.
The network must be working before others unpack.
The first truck is the only one with padding.
The equipment lease expires at noon.
questions.explanation: 10시 14분에 Ms. El-Sayed가 "IT goes on the first truck. We need the network up at the new place before anyone else unpacks."라고 말합니다. 다른 직원들이 짐을 풀기 전에 네트워크가 작동해야 하기 때문이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. El-Sayed do at noon?
options: Go to the new office to meet a technician
Ride in the first truck with Mr. Berger
Call the internet provider to reschedule
Prop open the door at the reception desk
questions.explanation: 인터넷 기사가 오후 1시에 새 사무실에 오기로 했고 누군가 문을 열어 줘야 한다는 말에, Ms. El-Sayed는 10시 17분에 "I'll head over at noon"이라고 답합니다. 기사를 맞이하러 정오에 새 사무실로 가는 것이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 트럭에 동승하여 서버를 설치하는 사람은 Mr. Berger입니다.

passage:
Owen McNally (8:12 A.M.): Morning, AV crew. Sound check for the Delmore Conference main stage is at 9. The keynote speaker's slides just arrived—forty minutes late.
Rachel Iwu (8:14 A.M.): Loading them onto the playback laptop now. Heads-up: the file is 4K video heavy. Our backup laptop can't handle that resolution.
Owen McNally (8:15 A.M.): Then the primary laptop cannot fail. Did you test the spare HDMI run to the projector?
Rachel Iwu (8:17 A.M.): Yesterday, yes. Both lines are live.
Dietrich Mann (8:19 A.M.): Problem in Breakout Room B. One of the wireless microphone receivers is picking up interference—a buzzing every few seconds.
Owen McNally (8:21 A.M.): Swap frequencies with the spare channel. The frequency chart is taped inside the rack.
Dietrich Mann (8:24 A.M.): Tried that. The buzz follows the receiver, not the channel.
Owen McNally (8:26 A.M.): Then pull the unit from Room D. That session doesn't begin until 1 P.M., and the rental house can courier a replacement by noon.
Dietrich Mann (8:27 A.M.): Swapping now. I'll call the rental house right after.
Rachel Iwu (8:29 A.M.): Slides loaded and playing smoothly. See everyone at the stage at 8:45.

questions.question: Where do the writers most likely work?
options: At a television studio
At an audiovisual support team for a conference
At a computer repair shop
At a musical instrument rental company
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지의 "AV crew", "Sound check for the Delmore Conference main stage", 무선 마이크와 프로젝터 관련 대화 등을 통해 이들이 컨퍼런스의 음향·영상(AV) 지원 팀임을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the backup laptop?
options: It is unable to play high-resolution video.
It was sent to the rental house for repair.
It is currently in Breakout Room B.
It arrived forty minutes late.
questions.explanation: 8시 14분에 Ms. Iwu가 발표 파일에 4K 영상이 많은데 "Our backup laptop can't handle that resolution"이라고 말합니다. 예비 노트북이 고해상도 영상을 재생할 수 없다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 40분 늦게 도착한 것은 발표 슬라이드입니다.

questions.question: At 8:24 A.M., what does Mr. Mann most likely mean when he writes, "The buzz follows the receiver, not the channel"?
options: The interference is caused by the faulty equipment itself.
The buzzing sound can only be heard near the stage.
The frequency chart in the rack is outdated.
The microphone works on every channel he tested.
questions.explanation: 주파수를 바꿔 보라는 지시에 Mr. Mann은 이미 시도했으며 잡음이 채널이 아니라 수신기를 따라다닌다고 답합니다. 즉, 주파수 간섭이 아니라 수신기 장비 자체의 결함이 원인이라는 뜻이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 그래서 Mr. McNally가 Room D의 장비로 교체하라고 지시한 것입니다.

questions.question: Why is it acceptable to take equipment from Room D?
options: The room has two spare receivers.
The session there was canceled.
No session is scheduled there until the afternoon.
The room is being used for storage.
questions.explanation: 8시 26분에 Mr. McNally는 Room D의 장비를 빼서 쓰라고 하면서 "That session doesn't begin until 1 P.M."이라고 이유를 설명합니다. 그 방의 세션이 오후 1시에야 시작하고, 정오까지 대여 업체가 대체 장비를 보내 줄 수 있기 때문입니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Camille Roy (4:40 P.M.): Team, the panel discussion in Hall 2 is running fifteen minutes over. The product launch in the same hall is scheduled for 5:30.
Jae-won Park (4:42 P.M.): The launch needs a full stage reset—podium out, demo tables in, plus the lighting preset change. That's normally a forty-minute job.
Camille Roy (4:43 P.M.): We'll have twenty-five at best.
Jae-won Park (4:45 P.M.): If Theo helps me, we can pre-rig the demo tables backstage now and roll them on in one go.
Theo Brandt (4:46 P.M.): I'm finishing cable teardown in Hall 1. Give me ten minutes.
Camille Roy (4:48 P.M.): What about lighting? Min-ji programmed the launch preset, but she's gone home sick.
Jae-won Park (4:50 P.M.): She saved everything to the console. I watched her do it. One button.
Camille Roy (4:51 P.M.): That's a relief. Theo, when you get here, take the stage-left side. I'll ask the panel moderator to wrap up by 5:05.
Theo Brandt (4:53 P.M.): Copy. Rolling my cart over now.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Roy describe?
options: A product demonstration was canceled.
A speaker has not arrived at Hall 2.
An ongoing event is reducing the available setup time.
A lighting console has stopped working.
questions.explanation: 4시 40분 메시지에서 패널 토론이 15분 초과 진행 중이고 같은 홀에서 5시 30분에 제품 출시 행사가 예정되어 있다고 알립니다. 이후 "We'll have twenty-five at best"라며 무대 전환 시간이 부족함을 말하므로, 진행 중인 행사 때문에 준비 시간이 줄어든다는 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Park suggest?
options: Assembling some equipment in advance backstage
Moving the product launch to Hall 1
Asking Min-ji to return to the venue
Canceling the lighting preset change
questions.explanation: 4시 45분에 Mr. Park은 Theo가 도와주면 "we can pre-rig the demo tables backstage now and roll them on in one go"라고 제안합니다. 시연 테이블을 무대 뒤에서 미리 설치해 두었다가 한 번에 옮기자는 것이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 4:50 P.M., what does Mr. Park most likely mean when he writes, "One button"?
options: A console button needs to be repaired before 5:30.
Applying the lighting settings will be very simple.
Only one lighting fixture is working in Hall 2.
Min-ji must press the button herself.
questions.explanation: 조명 담당자인 Min-ji가 아파서 퇴근했다는 걱정에, Mr. Park은 그녀가 모든 설정을 콘솔에 저장해 두었고 자신이 그 과정을 지켜봤다며 "One button"이라고 말합니다. 버튼 하나만 누르면 조명 프리셋이 적용될 만큼 간단하다는 의미이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 그래서 Ms. Roy가 "That's a relief"라고 안도한 것입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Roy most likely do next?
options: Program a new lighting preset
Help Mr. Brandt tear down cables in Hall 1
Speak with the moderator about ending the panel sooner
Move the demo tables onto the stage
questions.explanation: 4시 51분에 Ms. Roy는 "I'll ask the panel moderator to wrap up by 5:05"라고 말합니다. 패널 토론 사회자에게 5시 5분까지 마무리해 달라고 요청하겠다는 것이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Gloria Mendes (9:02 P.M.): Stocktake night, everyone. Store's closed, scanners are charged, and pizza arrives at 11. Aisles 1-6 are Team A, 7-12 Team B, stockroom is Team C.
Liam Doyle (9:05 P.M.): Team B here. Scanner 14 won't sync. It counts, but nothing uploads to the inventory system.
Gloria Mendes (9:07 P.M.): Restart it twice. If that fails, swap it for one of the spares at the service desk.
Liam Doyle (9:12 P.M.): Spare works. We're moving again.
Aisha Karim (9:30 P.M.): Stockroom update: we found two pallets of garden furniture that aren't in the system at all. No purchase order attached.
Gloria Mendes (9:32 P.M.): Seriously? Don't count them yet. Photograph the pallet labels and send them to me. I'll check with the buying office tomorrow.
Aisha Karim (9:34 P.M.): Photos coming. Also, Team C will finish early—maybe by midnight.
Gloria Mendes (9:36 P.M.): In that case, send half your team to help Aisles 7-12. Liam's section has the small electronics, and those take forever.
Liam Doyle (9:37 P.M.): We'll take all the help we can get.

questions.question: What are the writers mainly doing?
options: Preparing a store for a grand opening
Counting merchandise after business hours
Rearranging shelves for a seasonal sale
Training new employees on cash registers
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지의 "Stocktake night", "Store's closed, scanners are charged"와 구역별 팀 배정, 재고 시스템 업로드 언급 등으로 보아 영업시간 후 재고 조사를 하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How did Mr. Doyle resolve his equipment problem?
options: By restarting the device twice
By using a replacement device
By uploading the counts manually
By calling a technical support line
questions.explanation: 스캐너 14번이 동기화되지 않는다는 문제에 Ms. Mendes가 재시작 후 안 되면 예비 기기로 교체하라고 했고, 9시 12분에 Mr. Doyle이 "Spare works"라고 답했습니다. 예비(교체) 기기를 사용해 해결했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 9:32 P.M., what does Ms. Mendes most likely mean when she writes, "Seriously?"?
options: She is surprised that unrecorded stock was discovered.
She doubts that Team C counted correctly.
She is upset that the pizza has not arrived.
She thinks the garden furniture is damaged.
questions.explanation: Ms. Karim이 시스템에 전혀 등록되지 않은 정원 가구 팔레트 두 개를 발견했다고 보고하자, Ms. Mendes는 "Seriously?"라고 반응하며 아직 세지 말고 라벨을 촬영해 보내라고 합니다. 구매 주문서도 없는 미등록 재고가 나왔다는 사실에 놀랐다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Mendes want some of Team C to assist Team B?
options: Team B's scanner is still not working.
Team B's section includes items that are slow to count.
Team C miscounted the garden furniture.
Team B has only one member tonight.
questions.explanation: 9시 36분에 Ms. Mendes는 "Liam's section has the small electronics, and those take forever"라고 말합니다. Team B 구역에 소형 전자제품이 있어 세는 데 시간이 매우 오래 걸리기 때문에 일찍 끝나는 Team C 인원 절반을 보내려는 것입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Bruno Esposito (10:48 P.M.): Variance report from Aisle 3: the system says 240 bottles of the SunCoast shampoo, but we keep getting 198 on the shelf.
Nadia Petrov (10:50 P.M.): Did you check the promotional end cap near the registers? A lot of that shampoo was moved there for the two-for-one deal.
Bruno Esposito (10:53 P.M.): That's it. Forty-one bottles on the end cap. We're off by one now, not forty-two.
Nadia Petrov (10:54 P.M.): One is within tolerance. Log it and move on.
Hugo Lefevre (10:57 P.M.): Quick question—do we count the items in the damaged goods bin, too? There's a dented case of olive oil back here.
Nadia Petrov (10:59 P.M.): Yes, but scan them under the damage code, not the regular barcode. Otherwise the totals will be wrong.
Hugo Lefevre (11:01 P.M.): Understood. Also, the freezer aisle team says their handheld printer is out of labels.
Nadia Petrov (11:03 P.M.): There's a fresh roll in the cabinet behind the service desk. Top shelf, blue box.
Hugo Lefevre (11:05 P.M.): Grabbing it now. We're on track to finish by 1 A.M.

questions.question: Why was there a difference in the shampoo count?
options: Some bottles had been placed in a different location.
Several cases were damaged in the stockroom.
The system had recorded a delivery twice.
Customers had purchased bottles during the count.

The count must be repeated one more time.

passage:
Dispatch - Renata Alves (5:50 A.M.): Morning shift, Flight VK212 to Lisbon now departs from Gate 14 instead of Gate 22. Pushback still scheduled for 7:35.
Kofi Mensah (5:52 A.M.): Copy. My baggage cart team is staged at 22. We'll reposition, but the belt loader at 14 was tagged for maintenance last night.
Renata Alves (5:54 A.M.): Checking the equipment log... You're right. The work order is still open.

Renata Alves (5:57 A.M.): Approved. Log the move in the system so the next shift knows where it is.
Sofia Brandt (6:01 A.M.): Fueling update for VK212—the tanker is delayed behind a de-icing queue. Earliest start is 6:40.
Renata Alves (6:03 A.M.): That's cutting it close. Fueling takes about forty minutes for this aircraft.

Renata Alves (6:06 A.M.): Do it, and copy me on the request. Kofi, start loading as soon as the bags arrive at 14.

questions.question: What problem exists at Gate 14?

The baggage carts cannot reach the gate.
A de-icing truck is blocking the area.
questions.explanation: 5시 52분에 Mr. Mensah가 "the belt loader at 14 was tagged for maintenance last night"이라고 말하고, Ms. Alves도 장비 일지를 확인한 후 정비 작업 지시가 아직 미완료 상태라고 확인합니다. 14번 게이트의 수하물 적재 장비(벨트 로더)가 사용 불가 상태이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 6:03 A.M., what does Ms. Alves most likely mean when she writes, "That's cutting it close"?
options: The fueling may not finish much before departure.
The tanker is too close to the de-icing queue.
The baggage must be weighed before loading.
Gate 16 is too far from Gate 14.
questions.explanation: 급유 시작이 빨라야 6시 40분이라는 보고에 Ms. Alves는 "That's cutting it close"라고 답하며 이 기종의 급유에 약 40분이 걸린다고 덧붙입니다. 7시 35분 출발(pushback)까지 시간 여유가 거의 없다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Brandt offer to do?
options: Move the belt loader from Gate 16
Request priority over two other flights
Delay the 10:10 arrival
Update the equipment log
questions.explanation: 6시 5분에 Ms. Brandt는 연료 데스크에 화물기 두 편보다 먼저 급유해 달라고 요청하겠다("I'll ask the fuel desk to bump us ahead of the two cargo flights")고 합니다. 다른 두 항공편보다 우선순위를 요청하는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 벨트 로더 이동과 장비 일지 기록은 Mr. Mensah의 업무입니다.

Yusuf Demir (1:15 P.M.): Ramp team, weather alert: lightning detected within ten kilometers. All outdoor operations stop now per safety policy.
Clara Voss (1:16 P.M.): We're halfway through unloading Flight NA88. Bags are on the carts but uncovered.
Yusuf Demir (1:18 P.M.): Leave them and get your crew inside. Carts can be covered after the all-clear.
Clara Voss (1:19 P.M.): It's starting to rain hard. Those bags will be soaked.
Yusuf Demir (1:20 P.M.): Soaked bags can be dried. Get everyone off the ramp.
Clara Voss (1:22 P.M.): Understood. All six of us are heading to the break room.
Mateo Silva (1:31 P.M.): Operations says the connecting passengers on NA88 are asking about their luggage. Two have a 2:10 departure.
Yusuf Demir (1:33 P.M.): Tell the transfer desk those bags won't make it. They should rebook the bags on the 4:25 to the same destination.
Mateo Silva (1:35 P.M.): Passing that along. Radar shows the storm cell clearing by 1:50.
Yusuf Demir (1:36 P.M.): Good. Everyone be ready to resume the moment the all-clear sounds.

questions.question: Why did Mr. Demir stop work on the ramp?

Lightning was detected nearby.
A flight was switched to another gate.
The crew's shift had ended.

questions.question: At 1:20 P.M., what does Mr. Demir most likely mean when he writes, "Soaked bags can be dried"?
options: The baggage will be cleaned before delivery.
Worker safety matters more than protecting the luggage.
The rain is not expected to last long.
The carts have waterproof covers available.
questions.explanation: Ms. Voss가 비가 거세져 수하물이 젖을 것이라고 걱정하자, Mr. Demir는 "Soaked bags can be dried. Get everyone off the ramp."라고 답합니다. 젖은 가방은 말리면 되지만 사람의 안전은 대체할 수 없으니 직원 안전이 우선이라는 의미입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about some passengers on Flight NA88?
options: They have a connecting flight at 2:10.
They lost their boarding passes.
They are waiting in the break room.
They complained about the rebooking fee.
questions.explanation: 1시 31분에 Mr. Silva가 NA88편의 환승 승객들이 짐에 대해 문의하고 있으며 그중 두 명은 2시 10분 출발편을 탄다("Two have a 2:10 departure")고 전합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Demir instruct Mr. Silva to communicate?
options: The storm will clear by 1:50.
The crew will resume work immediately.
Certain luggage should be put on a later flight.
The 2:10 departure has been delayed.
questions.explanation: 1시 33분에 Mr. Demir는 환승 데스크에 해당 수하물이 2시 10분 편에 실리지 못할 것이며, 같은 목적지로 가는 4시 25분 편에 다시 실어야 한다고 전하라고 지시합니다. 일부 수하물을 더 늦은 항공편에 옮겨 실으라는 내용이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Ingrid Halvorsen (3:05 P.M.): Layout team, files for the July issue of Coastal Living Quarterly go to the printer at 9 A.M. tomorrow. Status, please.
Paolo Ricci (3:07 P.M.): Features section is done except the lighthouse story. The writer just sent a revised version—it's 300 words longer than the slot.
Ingrid Halvorsen (3:09 P.M.): We locked the page count last week. Can you trim it without losing the interview quotes?
Paolo Ricci (3:11 P.M.): The quotes stay. I can cut the historical background—most of it repeats the sidebar anyway.
Ingrid Halvorsen (3:12 P.M.): Do it, then send the page to copyediting flagged as urgent.
Dana Whitfield (3:15 P.M.): Bigger issue here. The ad agency for Marlin Outfitters still hasn't delivered the back-cover file. The placeholder is in the layout.
Ingrid Halvorsen (3:17 P.M.): They're paying premium for that position. Call them—not e-mail—and tell them the absolute deadline is 6 P.M.
Dana Whitfield (3:19 P.M.): And if they miss it?
Ingrid Halvorsen (3:20 P.M.): Then the house ad for our subscription offer goes there, and their contract penalty clause kicks in.
Dana Whitfield (3:21 P.M.): Calling now.

questions.question: What kind of business do the writers most likely work for?

A printing company
A magazine publisher
A travel agency

questions.question: What is the problem with the lighthouse story?
options: The writer has missed a deadline.
It exceeds the space reserved for it.
Its interview quotes were not approved.
It repeats an article from a previous issue.
questions.explanation: 3시 7분에 Mr. Ricci가 수정 원고가 배정된 지면보다 300단어 더 길다("it's 300 words longer than the slot")고 보고합니다. 기사가 할당된 공간을 초과한다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 원고는 이미 도착했으므로 마감을 어긴 것이 아니며, 사이드바와 중복되는 것은 역사적 배경 부분입니다.

questions.question: At 3:11 P.M., what does Mr. Ricci most likely mean when he writes, "The quotes stay"?
options: He agrees to keep the interview material in the article.
He thinks the quotes should be moved to the sidebar.
He wants the writer to verify the quotes.
He believes the quotes are too long to print.

questions.question: According to Ms. Halvorsen, what will happen if the advertisement file does not arrive by 6 P.M.?
options: The printing will be postponed by one day.
The back cover will be left blank.
A promotion for the magazine will fill the space.
The agency will receive a discount on a future issue.
questions.explanation: 3시 20분에 Ms. Halvorsen은 마감을 어기면 "the house ad for our subscription offer goes there"라고 말합니다. 즉, 자사 구독 광고가 그 자리를 채우고 광고주에게는 계약상 위약 조항이 적용됩니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Felix Navarro (10:22 A.M.): Cover crisis for the anniversary issue. Legal flagged the main photo—the photographer's license only covers digital use, not print.
Grace Lim (10:24 A.M.): That photo is the whole cover concept. Can't we just buy the print rights?
Felix Navarro (10:26 A.M.): The agent quoted $4,800. Our entire photo budget for this issue has $900 left.
Grace Lim (10:27 A.M.): Ouch. What are our options?
Felix Navarro (10:29 A.M.): Two: rework the cover around the harbor illustration from page 34, or use one of the runner-up photos from the original shoot. We own those outright.
Rosa Quintero (10:31 A.M.): The runner-ups are on the shared drive. Honestly, the third one—the dawn shot—might be stronger than the flagged photo.
Grace Lim (10:33 A.M.): Pulling it up now... Rosa, you have a point. The colors even match our masthead.
Felix Navarro (10:35 A.M.): Then it's settled? I need to tell the printer by noon whether we're holding the cover form.
Grace Lim (10:36 A.M.): It's settled. I'll have the new cover composed within the hour. No need to hold anything.

questions.question: Why is the original cover photo unusable?

The usage rights do not include print publication.
The photographer asked for it to be withdrawn.
It does not match the magazine's masthead colors.

questions.question: Why can the magazine NOT purchase the print rights?
options: The cost is far more than the remaining budget.
The agent cannot be reached before noon.
The photographer has sold the rights to a competitor.
The legal department has prohibited the purchase.
questions.explanation: 10시 26분에 Mr. Navarro는 에이전트가 4,800달러를 제시했지만 이번 호 사진 예산에 900달러밖에 남지 않았다고 말합니다. 비용이 남은 예산을 크게 초과하기 때문이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 10:33 A.M., what does Ms. Lim most likely mean when she writes, "Rosa, you have a point"?
options: She agrees that the dawn photograph is a good choice.
She thinks Ms. Quintero should design the cover.
She believes the shared drive needs reorganizing.
She wants Ms. Quintero to negotiate with the agent.
questions.explanation: Ms. Quintero가 예비 사진 중 새벽 사진이 문제의 사진보다 오히려 더 나을 수 있다고 하자, Ms. Lim은 사진을 띄워 보고 "Rosa, you have a point. The colors even match our masthead."라고 답합니다. 새벽 사진이 좋은 선택이라는 데 동의한다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Lim most likely do next?
options: Contact the printer about a delay
Create a new cover design with the selected photo
Ask the photographer for a discount
Move the harbor illustration to the cover
questions.explanation: 10시 36분에 Ms. Lim은 "I'll have the new cover composed within the hour"라고 하며 인쇄소 작업을 보류할 필요도 없다고 말합니다. 선택된 새벽 사진으로 새 표지를 한 시간 내에 구성할 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 인쇄소에 연락하는 일은 Mr. Navarro의 몫이며, 항구 일러스트는 채택되지 않았습니다.

passage:

questions.question: Why does Mr. Webb need Ms. Fontaine's approval?

questions.question: At 6:47 P.M., what does Ms. Fontaine most likely mean when she writes, "You have it"?

She has already received the page proofs.
She believes he has the festival's e-mail.
She is sending him a portal password.
