questions.question: What does Ms. Fontaine ask Mr. Webb to do this evening?
options: Call the festival's ticket hotline
Send the completed files to the printer
Write a new restaurant review
Proofread page 58 one more time
questions.explanation: 6시 55분에 Ms. Fontaine은 수정이 끝나면 최종 파일을 내보내 오늘 밤 인쇄소 포털에 업로드하라고 요청합니다. 아침의 분주함에 미루고 싶지 않다고 했으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Dispatcher - Carmen Ruiz (8:35 A.M.): Schedule update, technicians. Mr. Aldrich on Pine Street canceled his 9 A.M. washing machine repair. Walt, that frees your morning slot.
Walt Jensen (8:37 A.M.): Convenient—I'm ten minutes from Pine Street. Anything nearby instead?
Carmen Ruiz (8:39 A.M.): Yes, an emergency call just came in. A refrigerator at the Maple Diner stopped cooling overnight. They're three blocks from your location.
Walt Jensen (8:40 A.M.): A restaurant fridge is a priority. Heading there now. Do we know the model?
Carmen Ruiz (8:42 A.M.): A Polarline C-900, commercial unit. You serviced it in March for a fan issue.
Walt Jensen (8:44 A.M.): I remember it. If it's the compressor this time, I don't carry C-900 compressors in the van.
Carmen Ruiz (8:45 A.M.): Dev has one—he stocked up for a job that got rescheduled.
Dev Chandra (8:47 A.M.): Confirmed, it's in my van. I'm at the Hartfield Apartments job until 10, but Walt can meet me here for the part.
Walt Jensen (8:48 A.M.): I'll diagnose first and call you if I need it. With luck it's just the relay.
Carmen Ruiz (8:50 A.M.): Keep me posted. The diner owner says they'll lose their weekend stock if it's not fixed today.

questions.question: Why did Ms. Ruiz first message Mr. Jensen?
options: To inform him that an appointment was canceled
To ask him to order a replacement part
To tell him a customer complained about a repair
To assign him to the Hartfield Apartments job
questions.explanation: 8시 35분 메시지에서 Ms. Ruiz는 Pine Street의 Mr. Aldrich가 9시 세탁기 수리 예약을 취소했고, 그래서 Walt의 오전 일정이 비게 되었다고 알립니다. 예약 취소를 알리기 위한 것이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the Maple Diner's refrigerator?
options: It was purchased in March.
It has been repaired by Mr. Jensen before.
It is no longer under warranty.
It needs a new fan installed.
questions.explanation: 8시 42분에 Ms. Ruiz가 "You serviced it in March for a fan issue"라고 말하고 Mr. Jensen도 기억한다고 답합니다. Mr. Jensen이 전에 수리한 적이 있는 기기이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 3월은 구입 시점이 아니라 수리 시점이며, 이번 고장의 원인은 아직 진단 전입니다.

questions.question: At 8:48 A.M., what does Mr. Jensen most likely mean when he writes, "With luck it's just the relay"?
options: He hopes the problem will not require the part Mr. Chandra has.
He expects the diagnosis to take all morning.
He thinks the diner should replace the refrigerator.
He believes Mr. Chandra installed the wrong relay.
questions.explanation: Mr. Jensen은 컴프레서가 고장이면 자기 밴에 부품이 없어 Dev에게 받아야 하는 상황에서, 먼저 진단해 보고 필요하면 연락하겠다며 "With luck it's just the relay"라고 말합니다. 운이 좋으면 (컴프레서가 아니라) 릴레이 문제여서 Dev의 부품이 필요 없기를 바란다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does the diner owner say about the situation?
options: The diner will close for the weekend.
Food supplies could spoil without a same-day repair.
A second refrigerator is also malfunctioning.
The repair cost should be covered by insurance.
questions.explanation: 8시 50분에 Ms. Ruiz가 식당 주인의 말을 전하며 "they'll lose their weekend stock if it's not fixed today"라고 합니다. 오늘 수리되지 않으면 주말 재고(식자재)를 잃게 된다는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Priti Anand (11:02 A.M.): Dispatch update: the customer at 44 Birchwood Lane reports her oven is showing error code E-15 again. We replaced the heating element there two weeks ago.
Stefan Krall (11:04 A.M.): E-15 on that model usually points to the temperature sensor, not the element. Who did the original job?
Priti Anand (11:06 A.M.): That was Omar's call. He's on leave this week.
Stefan Krall (11:08 A.M.): His notes should be in the work-order system. If he tested the sensor, it'll be logged.
Priti Anand (11:10 A.M.): Looking... He wrote "sensor readings borderline, advised customer it may need replacement within the year."
Stefan Krall (11:11 A.M.): There's our answer. I can take it after my 1 P.M. job in Fairview—Birchwood is on my way back.
Priti Anand (11:13 A.M.): The customer asked whether she'll be charged again. The element repair has a ninety-day guarantee.
Stefan Krall (11:15 A.M.): The guarantee covers the element, but the sensor is a separate component. She'd pay for the part; I'd waive the call-out fee since we flagged it earlier.
Priti Anand (11:16 A.M.): That's fair. I'll book you in for 3 P.M. and explain the charges when I confirm with her.

questions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: A recurring problem with a customer's appliance
A delayed shipment of heating elements
Mr. Krall's vacation schedule
A new error-code training course
questions.explanation: 대화는 2주 전에 수리했던 고객의 오븐에 다시 오류 코드가 떴다는 보고로 시작해, 원인 파악과 재방문 일정, 비용 안내까지 이어집니다. 고객 가전제품의 반복되는 문제를 다루고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 휴가 중인 사람은 Omar입니다.

questions.question: According to Mr. Krall, what does error code E-15 usually indicate?
options: A faulty heating element
A problem with a sensor
A power supply failure
An incorrect installation
questions.explanation: 11시 4분에 Mr. Krall은 "E-15 on that model usually points to the temperature sensor, not the element"라고 말합니다. 이 모델에서 E-15는 보통 가열 부품이 아니라 온도 센서 문제를 가리킨다는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 11:11 A.M., what does Mr. Krall most likely mean when he writes, "There's our answer"?
options: Omar has replied to his message.
The work-order notes confirm his suspicion about the cause.
The customer has agreed to pay for a new oven.
The error code has disappeared on its own.
questions.explanation: Omar의 작업 기록에 "센서 수치가 경계선 수준이며 1년 내 교체가 필요할 수 있다고 고객에게 안내함"이라고 적혀 있다는 보고에, Mr. Krall은 "There's our answer."라고 답합니다. 센서가 원인일 것이라는 자신의 추측이 기록으로 확인되었다는 의미이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Krall say about the charges for the new visit?
options: The entire repair will be free under the guarantee.
The customer will pay for both the part and the visit.
The customer will pay for the part but not the call-out fee.
The charges will be decided after Omar returns.
questions.explanation: 11시 15분에 Mr. Krall은 보증은 가열 부품에만 적용되고 센서는 별도 부품이므로 고객이 부품비는 내야 하지만, 이전에 미리 알렸던 사안이므로 출장비는 면제해 주겠다("I'd waive the call-out fee")고 말합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
Janet Mireles (2:10 P.M.): Fall schedule planning, everyone. We have three requests for Studio 2 on Tuesday evenings: pottery, salsa dance, and the photography club.
Bert Kowalski (2:12 P.M.): Pottery has to be in Studio 2—that's where the kilns and wheels are. It can't move.
Janet Mireles (2:14 P.M.): Agreed. So salsa and photography need new homes. The gym is free Tuesdays after 6.
Amara Diallo (2:16 P.M.): Salsa in the gym works if we can get the portable speakers. The mounted sound system there is still broken.
Bert Kowalski (2:18 P.M.): The speakers live in my office. Consider them reserved for you.
Janet Mireles (2:20 P.M.): And the photography club? They mainly need a dark room and a projector.
Amara Diallo (2:22 P.M.): The small meeting room upstairs has blackout curtains. We used it for the film series last winter.
Janet Mireles (2:24 P.M.): It only holds twelve people, though. The club listed eighteen members on their request form.
Bert Kowalski (2:26 P.M.): Their actual turnout is usually eight or nine. I supervise Tuesday evenings—I've never seen more than ten.
Janet Mireles (2:27 P.M.): Good enough. I'll offer them the meeting room and note the capacity limit, just in case.

questions.question: What are the writers trying to do?
options: Assign rooms for several evening classes
Hire instructors for fall programs
Repair a sound system in the gym
Plan a fund-raising event for the center
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 화요일 저녁 Studio 2 사용 요청이 세 건 겹쳤다고 알리고, 이후 각 강좌를 어느 공간에 배정할지 논의합니다. 저녁 강좌들의 공간 배정을 조율하는 대화이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why can the pottery class NOT be relocated?
options: Its instructor is unavailable on other days.
Its enrollment is too large for other rooms.
The equipment it requires is fixed in Studio 2.
Its sessions run later than the building's hours.
questions.explanation: 2시 12분에 Mr. Kowalski가 "Pottery has to be in Studio 2—that's where the kilns and wheels are. It can't move."라고 말합니다. 가마와 물레 등 필수 장비가 Studio 2에 설치되어 있어 옮길 수 없기 때문이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: At 2:18 P.M., what does Mr. Kowalski most likely mean when he writes, "Consider them reserved for you"?
options: He will let the salsa class use the portable speakers.
He has booked the gym for the photography club.
He will repair the mounted sound system.
He has signed Ms. Diallo up for the salsa class.
questions.explanation: Ms. Diallo가 휴대용 스피커만 구할 수 있다면 살사 수업을 체육관에서 해도 된다고 하자, Mr. Kowalski는 스피커가 자기 사무실에 있다며 "Consider them reserved for you"라고 답합니다. 살사 수업을 위해 스피커를 쓸 수 있게 해 주겠다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What concern does Ms. Mireles raise about the upstairs meeting room?
options: It has no blackout curtains.
Its capacity is smaller than the club's listed membership.
It is already booked for a film series.
Its projector is broken.
questions.explanation: 2시 24분에 Ms. Mireles는 그 방이 12명까지만 수용 가능한데 사진 동호회는 신청서에 회원 18명이라고 적었다고 우려합니다. 정원이 동호회의 등록 인원보다 적다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 암막 커튼은 그 방에 이미 있다고 했습니다.

passage: HARLOW CREEK (Business Weekly) — When Marisol Vega opened Dough & Daughters, a small bakery on Pinecrest Avenue, few expected it to survive its first winter. Five years later, the bakery employs fourteen people and ships its signature sourdough crackers to specialty shops in three neighboring states. Ms. Vega attributes the turnaround to a single decision: cutting her menu in half. "We were trying to please everyone," she said. "Once we focused on the six items we did best, quality went up and waste went down." The bakery also benefited from a partnership with Harlow Creek Community College, whose culinary students complete paid internships in its kitchen each semester. Several interns have stayed on as full-time staff. Last month, Dough & Daughters received the Chamber of Commerce's Small Business of the Year award, which includes a $10,000 grant. Ms. Vega plans to use the funds to install a second oven, allowing the bakery to double its wholesale output by next spring.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: The growth of a local bakery
A new culinary degree program
Rising food prices in Harlow Creek
A merger between two food companies
questions.explanation: 기사 전체가 Dough & Daughters라는 작은 빵집이 5년 만에 직원 14명을 둔 성공적인 사업체로 성장한 과정을 다루고 있습니다. 첫 문단부터 빵집의 생존과 확장을 설명하므로 (A) '지역 빵집의 성장'이 정답입니다. 요리 학위 프로그램(B)은 인턴십 협력으로만 언급되고, 식품 가격(C)이나 합병(D)은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the article, what decision helped the bakery succeed?
options: Lowering its prices
Reducing the number of menu items
Moving to a larger location
Extending its business hours
questions.explanation: Ms. Vega는 성공 요인으로 'cutting her menu in half'(메뉴를 절반으로 줄인 것)를 꼽았습니다. 가장 잘하는 6가지 품목에 집중하자 품질이 올라가고 낭비가 줄었다고 설명하므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 가격 인하, 이전, 영업시간 연장은 본문에 없는 내용입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the internship program?
options: It is open only to graduate students.
It lasts for a full year.
It has become a source of permanent employees.
It was funded by a government grant.
questions.explanation: 본문에 'Several interns have stayed on as full-time staff'(여러 인턴이 정규직으로 남았다)라고 명시되어 있어, 인턴십 프로그램이 정규 직원 채용의 통로가 되었음을 추론할 수 있습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 대학원생 한정(A), 1년 기간(B), 정부 보조금(D)은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Vega plan to do with the grant money?
options: Hire additional bakers
Open a second store
Purchase new equipment
Launch an advertising campaign
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 Ms. Vega는 상금 10,000달러를 'install a second oven'(두 번째 오븐 설치)에 사용할 계획이라고 했습니다. 오븐은 장비이므로 (C) '새 장비 구입'이 정답입니다. 직원 채용(A), 2호점 개설(B), 광고(D)는 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage: BRENFORD — [1] Ten years ago, Curtis Aoki was repairing bicycles out of a rented garage behind his apartment. Today, his company, Spoke & Sprocket, operates twelve service centers across the region and has just signed its first franchise agreement. [2] The company's rise has been driven by an unusual business model: customers pay a flat monthly fee that covers unlimited tune-ups, flat-tire repairs, and safety inspections. The subscription approach, rare in the bicycle trade, gives the company predictable revenue during slow winter months. [3] Mr. Aoki credits his early employees with refining the concept. "They heard the same complaints from riders every day, and we built the membership around solving them," he said. The new franchise location will open in Dale Harbor in September, operated by longtime store manager Priya Raman. [4] Mr. Aoki says he hopes to sign five more franchise agreements within two years, focusing on towns that currently lack a full-service bicycle shop.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the article?
options: To announce a bicycle race
To profile a growing local business
To review a new bicycle model
To explain changes to traffic laws
questions.explanation: 기사는 차고에서 자전거를 수리하던 Curtis Aoki가 12개 서비스 센터를 운영하는 회사로 성장시킨 과정과 첫 프랜차이즈 계약을 소개하는 인물·기업 특집 기사입니다. 따라서 (B) '성장하는 지역 사업체 소개'가 정답입니다. 자전거 경주(A), 신모델 리뷰(C), 교통법(D)은 본문과 무관합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about Spoke & Sprocket's business model?
options: It charges customers a recurring fee.
It sells bicycles exclusively online.
It was copied from a competitor.
It focuses on racing bicycles.
questions.explanation: 본문에 'customers pay a flat monthly fee'(고객이 매월 정액 요금을 지불한다)라는 구독형 모델이 설명되어 있으므로 (A) '반복 요금을 부과한다'가 정답입니다. 이 모델은 자전거 업계에서 드물다(rare)고 했으므로 경쟁사 모방(C)은 오답이며, 온라인 전용 판매(B)나 경주용 자전거 특화(D)는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: Who will manage the Dale Harbor location?
options: Curtis Aoki
A newly hired consultant
Priya Raman
A former competitor
questions.explanation: 본문에 'operated by longtime store manager Priya Raman'이라고 명시되어 있으므로, Dale Harbor의 새 프랜차이즈 지점은 오랜 매장 관리자인 Priya Raman이 운영합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "That stability has allowed it to keep all twelve locations open year-round."
questions.explanation: 삽입 문장의 'That stability'(그 안정성)는 바로 앞에서 언급된 '한가한 겨울철에도 예측 가능한 수익(predictable revenue during slow winter months)'을 가리킵니다. 구독 모델의 안정적 수익 설명 직후인 [3] 위치에 들어가야 '그 안정성 덕분에 12개 지점을 연중 운영할 수 있었다'는 논리적 연결이 자연스럽습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage: NATIONAL LABOR REPORT — Employers across the manufacturing and logistics sectors added 84,000 jobs last quarter, according to figures released Tuesday by the Bureau of Workforce Statistics. The gain marks the strongest quarter for blue-collar hiring in four years. Analysts attribute the surge to companies rebuilding domestic supply chains after years of overseas disruptions. However, the report also highlights a persistent challenge: nearly 60 percent of surveyed employers said they struggled to fill openings that require technical certifications, such as welding and industrial electrical work. In response, several large firms have begun covering the full cost of certification courses for new hires. Tarrant Mechanical, a parts manufacturer in Ohio, reported that its tuition program cut average time-to-hire from nine weeks to four. "We stopped waiting for qualified candidates to appear and started creating them," said human resources director Lena Okafor. Economists caution that hiring momentum could slow if interest rates rise, but most expect demand for skilled trade workers to remain strong through at least next year.

questions.question: What does the report mainly discuss?
options: A decline in factory production
Recent trends in hiring
New workplace safety regulations
An increase in employee resignations
questions.explanation: 보고서는 제조·물류 부문에서 지난 분기 84,000개의 일자리가 늘었다는 고용 통계와 채용 동향, 인력 확보의 어려움을 다루고 있습니다. 따라서 (B) '최근 채용 동향'이 정답입니다. 생산 감소(A), 안전 규정(C), 퇴사 증가(D)는 본문 내용과 다릅니다.

questions.question: According to the article, what problem do many employers face?
options: Finding workers with required certifications
Paying higher transportation costs
Complying with new tax rules
Retaining senior managers
questions.explanation: 설문에 응한 고용주의 약 60%가 용접, 산업 전기 작업 등 기술 자격증이 필요한 일자리를 채우는 데 어려움을 겪었다고 답했습니다('struggled to fill openings that require technical certifications'). 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: The word "covering" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
options: hiding
protecting
paying
reporting
questions.explanation: 'covering the full cost of certification courses'에서 cover는 비용을 '부담하다, 지불하다'라는 의미로 쓰였습니다. 따라서 (C) paying이 가장 가깝습니다. hide(숨기다), protect(보호하다), report(보도하다)는 이 문맥의 의미와 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Tarrant Mechanical?
options: It recently relocated overseas.
Its training investment reduced hiring time.
It plans to lay off workers next year.
It manufactures welding equipment.
questions.explanation: Tarrant Mechanical은 신입 직원의 자격증 과정 비용을 전액 지원하는 프로그램을 통해 평균 채용 소요 기간을 9주에서 4주로 줄였다고 보고했습니다. 따라서 교육 투자가 채용 시간을 단축했다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 해외 이전(A), 감원 계획(C), 용접 장비 제조(D)는 언급되지 않았습니다.

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Calloway Distribution Group announced today that it will hire 1,200 seasonal workers across its four regional warehouses ahead of the year-end shopping period. [1] Positions include package handlers, forklift operators, and inventory clerks, with shifts available around the clock. Seasonal employees will earn a starting wage of $19.50 per hour, a 10 percent increase over last year's rate, plus a completion bonus of $600 for those who remain through January 15. [2] "The holiday season accounts for nearly a third of our annual volume, and we want to reward the people who make it possible," said Chief Operating Officer Danielle Mercer. The company noted that more than 400 of last year's seasonal hires accepted permanent roles after the season ended. [3] Interested applicants can apply online at callowaydg.com/careers or attend one of the walk-in hiring events scheduled at each warehouse during the first week of October. [4] Offers will be extended within five business days of a completed interview.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the press release?
options: To announce a warehouse closing
To introduce a new executive
To publicize temporary job openings
To report quarterly earnings
questions.explanation: 보도자료는 연말 쇼핑 시즌을 앞두고 1,200명의 계절(임시) 직원을 채용한다는 내용을 알리고 있습니다. 따라서 (C) '임시 일자리 공고 홍보'가 정답입니다. 창고 폐쇄(A), 신임 임원 소개(B), 분기 실적 보고(D)는 본문의 목적이 아닙니다.

questions.question: How does this year's starting wage compare with last year's?
options: It is the same.
It is 10 percent higher.
It is slightly lower.
It has not yet been decided.
questions.explanation: 본문에 시작 시급 19.50달러가 'a 10 percent increase over last year's rate'(작년 대비 10% 인상)라고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about last year's seasonal workers?
options: Many of them became permanent employees.
They all received a completion bonus.
Most of them worked night shifts.
They were hired through a staffing agency.
questions.explanation: 본문에 'more than 400 of last year's seasonal hires accepted permanent roles'(작년 계절 직원 중 400명 이상이 정규직 제안을 수락했다)라고 나와 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 완료 보너스 전원 수령(B), 야간 근무(C), 인력 파견업체(D)는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "No prior warehouse experience is necessary, as paid training is provided during the first week."
questions.explanation: 삽입 문장은 '사전 창고 경력이 필요 없으며 첫 주에 유급 교육이 제공된다'는 지원 자격 관련 안내입니다. 지원 방법(온라인 지원, 현장 채용 행사)을 설명한 직후이자 면접 후 채용 제안 안내 앞인 [4] 위치에 들어가야 지원자 대상 안내의 흐름이 자연스럽습니다. 따라서 (D)가 정답입니다.

passage: MERIDIAN CITY — The city council voted 7–2 on Monday to approve the Riverside Quarter plan, an ambitious redevelopment of the long-neglected industrial waterfront. The fifteen-year project will convert forty hectares of disused warehouses and rail yards into a mixed-use district featuring 3,500 housing units, a public riverfront promenade, and space for small manufacturers and design studios. Under the approved agreement, developer Northgate Partners must reserve 25 percent of the housing for moderate-income residents and fund the restoration of the century-old Dockside Crane, which will remain as a landmark. Construction of the first phase, which includes the promenade and 800 apartments, is expected to begin next spring and finish within three years. Some residents of the adjacent Felton neighborhood have voiced concerns about construction noise and rising rents. In response, the council established a community oversight board that will meet quarterly and review complaints. "This is the largest investment in the waterfront in our city's history," said Mayor Alicia Trent. "We intend to get it right."

questions.question: What did the city council do on Monday?
options: It rejected a housing proposal.
It approved a redevelopment plan.
It elected a new mayor.
It raised property taxes.
questions.explanation: 첫 문장에서 시의회가 7대 2로 Riverside Quarter 재개발 계획을 승인했다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 계획은 거부된 것이 아니라 승인되었고(A), 시장 선출(C)이나 재산세 인상(D)은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is Northgate Partners required to do?
options: Build a new city hall
Demolish the Dockside Crane
Set aside housing for moderate-income residents
Relocate existing manufacturers
questions.explanation: 승인된 협약에 따라 개발사 Northgate Partners는 주택의 25%를 중간 소득층 주민을 위해 확보해야('reserve 25 percent of the housing for moderate-income residents') 합니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. Dockside Crane은 철거가 아니라 복원 대상이므로 (B)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: The word "voiced" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
options: expressed
sang
recorded
denied
questions.explanation: 'voiced concerns'는 우려를 '표명했다'는 의미입니다. 따라서 (A) expressed가 가장 가깝습니다. sing(노래하다), record(녹음하다), deny(부인하다)는 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: How did the council respond to residents' concerns?
options: By delaying the project for a year
By reducing the number of apartments
By creating an oversight board
By offering tax refunds
questions.explanation: 공사 소음과 임대료 상승을 우려하는 주민들에 대응하여 시의회는 분기마다 모여 민원을 검토하는 'community oversight board'(주민 감독 위원회)를 설립했습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage: GRANVILLE GAZETTE — For nearly a decade, the hulking Atherton Textile Mill stood empty at the edge of downtown, its windows boarded and its smokestack dark. [1] That changes this weekend, when the renovated complex reopens as Mill Works, a hub for food vendors, artisan workshops, and offices. [2] Developer Corbin & Yates spent three years and $42 million on the conversion, preserving the building's original brick walls, timber beams, and freight elevators. The project received a state heritage grant that covered roughly one-fifth of the cost, on the condition that the facade remain unchanged. [3] The ground floor will house a public market with twenty-two stalls, while the upper floors offer studio space already leased to a furniture maker, two architecture firms, and a pottery school. City planners hope Mill Works will draw foot traffic to the quiet east end of downtown, where several storefronts have sat vacant. [4] A similar conversion of the nearby Harmon Foundry is scheduled to begin next year if permits are approved.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: The closure of a textile factory
The conversion of an old building into a commercial space
A dispute between developers and the city
The history of the textile industry
questions.explanation: 기사는 10년 가까이 비어 있던 Atherton 방직 공장이 식품 매장, 공방, 사무실이 들어서는 Mill Works로 개조되어 재개장한다는 내용입니다. 따라서 (B) '오래된 건물의 상업 공간 전환'이 정답입니다. 공장 폐쇄(A)는 과거 배경일 뿐이고, 분쟁(C)이나 산업 역사(D)는 중심 내용이 아닙니다.

questions.question: What condition was attached to the state grant?
options: The building's exterior had to be preserved.
Rents had to remain below market rates.
Construction had to finish within one year.
Local workers had to be hired.
questions.explanation: 주(州) 문화유산 보조금은 'on the condition that the facade remain unchanged'(외관을 변경하지 않는 조건으로) 지급되었습니다. facade는 건물 정면·외관을 뜻하므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a tenant of the upper floors?
options: A furniture maker
Architecture firms
A pottery school
A software company
questions.explanation: 상층부 입주 업체로 가구 제작자, 건축 사무소 두 곳, 도예 학교가 언급되었습니다. 소프트웨어 회사(D)는 본문에 없으므로 정답입니다. NOT 문제는 본문에 언급된 보기를 하나씩 소거하며 풀어야 합니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Officials believe the market alone could attract several thousand visitors each week."
questions.explanation: 삽입 문장의 'the market'은 바로 앞 문장에서 소개된 1층의 'public market with twenty-two stalls'를 가리키며, 시 관계자들이 유동 인구 유입을 기대한다는 내용과도 이어집니다. 시장 소개와 동선 활성화 기대가 언급된 직후인 [4] 위치가 가장 자연스러우므로 (D)가 정답입니다.

passage: HOSPITALITY MONITOR — Hotel occupancy in the Westbrook metropolitan area reached 78 percent in May, the highest figure for that month since record-keeping began, according to an industry report published Thursday by the Calder Hospitality Institute. The report links the increase to a rebound in business travel, which had lagged behind leisure travel for several years. Conference bookings at the city's convention center are up 31 percent compared with the same period last year, and midweek room rates have climbed accordingly, averaging $214 per night. Notably, extended-stay properties posted the strongest gains, a trend the report attributes to corporate clients sending employees on multi-week assignments rather than short trips. Not all segments shared in the growth, however. Budget motels along Highway 9 reported flat occupancy, which analysts blame on reduced road-trip traffic. The institute forecasts that the metropolitan area will need an additional 1,400 rooms within five years to meet projected demand, and notes that three hotel projects totaling 620 rooms are already under construction downtown.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the report?
options: Declining restaurant revenues
Hotel performance in the Westbrook area
New airline routes to Westbrook
Renovations at a convention center
questions.explanation: 보고서는 Westbrook 대도시권의 호텔 객실 점유율이 5월 기준 사상 최고인 78%를 기록했다는 내용과 그 원인, 세부 동향을 다룹니다. 따라서 (B) 'Westbrook 지역의 호텔 실적'이 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does the report identify as the cause of the occupancy increase?
options: A rise in business travel
A new sports stadium
Lower room rates
An advertising campaign
questions.explanation: 보고서는 점유율 상승을 'a rebound in business travel'(출장 수요의 회복)과 연결지었습니다. 컨벤션 센터의 회의 예약이 31% 증가했다는 내용도 이를 뒷받침합니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 객실 요금은 오히려 올랐으므로 (C)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: The word "posted" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
options: mailed
displayed
recorded
announced
questions.explanation: 'extended-stay properties posted the strongest gains'에서 post는 실적·수치를 '기록하다'라는 의미로 쓰였습니다. 따라서 (C) recorded가 가장 가깝습니다. mail(우편으로 보내다), display(전시하다)는 문맥에 맞지 않으며, announce(발표하다)는 수치를 달성했다는 의미를 담지 못합니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about budget motels along Highway 9?
options: They are being converted into apartments.
They did not benefit from the recent growth.
They raised their rates by 31 percent.
They cater mainly to business travelers.
questions.explanation: 본문에 'Not all segments shared in the growth'라며 Highway 9 변의 저가 모텔들은 점유율이 제자리(flat occupancy)였다고 했습니다. 즉 최근 성장의 혜택을 받지 못했다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 분석가들은 그 원인을 자동차 여행 감소로 보았습니다.

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Lantern Hill Hotels, the boutique hospitality group known for restoring historic properties, announced today the opening of its eighth location, the 64-room Lantern Hill Savoyard in central Kelmsford. [1] The property occupies a former opera house built in 1908, and its guest rooms retain original plasterwork, stage-curtain motifs, and restored hardwood floors. [2] Amenities include a rooftop reading lounge, a ground-floor brasserie led by chef Tomas Reyes, and a small performance hall that will host monthly chamber music concerts open to the public. In keeping with the group's practices, at least 70 percent of the food served on-site will be sourced from farms within 100 kilometers. [3] "Travelers increasingly want a stay that tells them something about the place they are visiting," said founder Geneva Holt. "A bland room could be anywhere. Our properties could only be where they are." [4] Opening-month guests will receive complimentary tickets to the inaugural concert on August 9. Room reservations are now available at lanternhillhotels.com.

questions.question: What is being announced?
options: The renovation of an opera company's offices
The opening of a new hotel
A change in hotel ownership
The retirement of a company founder
questions.explanation: 보도자료는 Lantern Hill Hotels의 여덟 번째 지점인 Lantern Hill Savoyard 호텔의 개장을 알리고 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 건물이 과거 오페라 하우스였다는 것은 배경 설명일 뿐이며(A), 소유권 변경(C)이나 창립자 은퇴(D)는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the hotel building?
options: It was constructed last year.
It previously served a different purpose.
It is the company's largest property.
It is located outside the city center.
questions.explanation: 호텔은 1908년에 지어진 'a former opera house'(옛 오페라 하우스) 건물에 들어섰으므로, 과거에 다른 용도로 사용되었다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 위치는 'central Kelmsford'(도심)이므로 (D)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What can be inferred about Lantern Hill Hotels?
options: It emphasizes local character in its properties.
It plans to sell its older locations.
It operates mainly airport hotels.
It will close the performance hall to the public.
questions.explanation: 창립자 Geneva Holt의 말 — '평범한 방은 어디에나 있을 수 있지만, 우리 호텔은 그 장소에만 있을 수 있다' — 과 반경 100km 이내 농장에서 식자재 70% 이상을 조달한다는 방침에서, 이 회사가 지역적 특색을 중시함을 추론할 수 있습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 공연장은 대중에게 공개되므로 (D)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The restoration took twenty-two months and employed local craftspeople for much of the detailed work."
questions.explanation: 삽입 문장은 복원 공사 기간과 지역 장인 고용에 관한 내용으로, 건물이 1908년 오페라 하우스였고 원래의 석고 장식과 마룻바닥이 복원되었다는 설명 바로 뒤인 [2] 위치에 들어가야 복원 작업에 대한 서술이 자연스럽게 이어집니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage: AGRITECH JOURNAL — Verdana Farms, which grows leafy greens in a converted distribution warehouse on the outskirts of Pell City, announced this week that it has reached profitability after four years of operation — a milestone that has eluded many vertical farming ventures. The company stacks lettuce, basil, and kale in trays under tuned LED lights, using 95 percent less water than conventional field farming and no pesticides. Industry observers note that several high-profile vertical farms have shut down in recent years, undone by electricity costs that consumed their margins. Verdana's chief executive, Dr. Imani Walsh, says the company survived by signing a long-term power agreement with a nearby solar facility and by selling exclusively within a 50-kilometer radius, which keeps produce fresher and trucking costs minimal. The company supplies thirty-two grocery stores and fourteen restaurants, and its basil now outsells imported alternatives at several major chains. Verdana plans to break ground on a second growing facility in Halton County next year, which is expected to create about sixty jobs.

questions.question: What recent achievement did Verdana Farms announce?
options: It became profitable.
It acquired a competitor.
It patented a new lighting system.
It exported produce overseas.
questions.explanation: Verdana Farms는 운영 4년 만에 흑자 전환(reached profitability)을 발표했습니다. 이는 많은 수직 농장 기업들이 이루지 못한 이정표라고 설명되어 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the article, why have some vertical farms closed?
options: Consumer demand was too low.
Electricity costs were too high.
Water supplies were limited.
Pesticide regulations changed.
questions.explanation: 본문에 여러 유명 수직 농장이 'undone by electricity costs that consumed their margins'(이윤을 잠식한 전기 요금 때문에 무너졌다)라고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How did Verdana Farms control its energy expenses?
options: By operating only at night
By reducing its growing space
By contracting with a solar power facility
By building its own wind turbines
questions.explanation: CEO인 Dr. Walsh는 인근 태양광 발전 시설과 장기 전력 공급 계약('a long-term power agreement with a nearby solar facility')을 맺어 회사가 생존할 수 있었다고 밝혔습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Verdana's distribution strategy?
options: It relies on overnight air freight.
It limits sales to nearby customers.
It focuses on online subscriptions.
It depends on a single supermarket chain.
questions.explanation: Verdana는 반경 50km 이내에서만 판매('selling exclusively within a 50-kilometer radius')하여 신선도를 유지하고 운송비를 최소화합니다. 따라서 가까운 고객에게만 판매한다는 (B)가 정답입니다. 식료품점 32곳과 식당 14곳에 공급하므로 단일 체인 의존(D)은 오답입니다.

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — SkyFurrow Analytics, a developer of agricultural drone systems, today announced the commercial launch of FieldScan 3, a monitoring service that helps growers detect crop stress before it is visible to the eye. [1] Drones equipped with multispectral cameras fly programmed routes over fields, and the company's software flags areas showing early signs of drought stress, nutrient deficiency, or pest damage. Subscribing farmers receive a color-coded map within two hours of each flight, along with recommended actions. [2] During a two-season pilot program involving forty grain farms in the Drummond Valley, participants reduced fertilizer use by an average of 18 percent while maintaining yields. [3] "Farmers have always walked their fields; we simply let them see what walking can't show," said cofounder and chief agronomist Dr. Petra Lindqvist. FieldScan 3 subscriptions start at $4 per hectare per month, with discounts for cooperatives. [4] The company will demonstrate the system at the Midlands Agricultural Expo in Caldwell on July 18 and 19.

questions.question: What does FieldScan 3 do?
options: It plants seeds automatically.
It identifies early problems in crops.
It forecasts weekly weather conditions.
It transports harvested grain.
questions.explanation: FieldScan 3는 다중분광 카메라를 장착한 드론으로 밭을 비행하며 가뭄 스트레스, 영양 결핍, 해충 피해의 초기 징후를 눈에 보이기 전에 감지하는 서비스입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 파종(A), 일기예보(C), 곡물 운송(D)은 본문에 없습니다.

questions.question: What was a result of the pilot program?
options: Crop yields doubled.
Farms used less fertilizer.
Fuel costs increased.
Several farms left the program.
questions.explanation: Drummond Valley의 곡물 농장 40곳이 참여한 2시즌 시범 프로그램에서 참가자들은 수확량을 유지하면서 비료 사용을 평균 18% 줄였습니다('reduced fertilizer use by an average of 18 percent'). 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 수확량은 두 배가 아니라 유지된 것이므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What will happen on July 18?
options: A subscription discount will end.
A new cofounder will be named.
A product demonstration will take place.
A pilot program will begin.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 회사는 7월 18~19일 Caldwell에서 열리는 Midlands Agricultural Expo에서 시스템을 시연할('demonstrate the system') 예정이라고 했습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Those savings alone more than covered the cost of the subscription, according to the company."
questions.explanation: 삽입 문장의 'Those savings'(그 절감액)는 시범 프로그램에서 비료 사용을 평균 18% 줄였다는 내용을 가리킵니다. 절감 효과가 구독 비용을 상회했다는 부연이므로, 비료 절감 결과가 제시된 직후인 [3] 위치가 가장 자연스럽습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage: ARTS & COMMERCE DESK — The Fennimore Museum of Art reported Tuesday that its summer exhibition, "Light on Water: The Coastal Impressionists," drew 312,000 visitors over its fourteen-week run, the highest attendance in the museum's history. The show's success carried well beyond ticket sales. Museum shop revenue tripled compared with the same period last year, memberships rose by 4,800, and nearby restaurants reported noticeably busier weekends, according to the downtown business alliance. Museum director Charlotte Iwu credited the exhibition's design, which paired the paintings with interactive displays explaining the chemistry of nineteenth-century pigments. "Visitors stayed an average of forty minutes longer than they do for a typical show," Ms. Iwu noted. The museum spent an unprecedented $1.1 million on marketing, including its first national television campaign, a gamble that some board members initially questioned. The strong returns have quieted those doubts. The museum announced that its next major exhibition, devoted to contemporary textile art, will open in February, and that timed-entry tickets will go on sale in November.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: The success of a museum exhibition
The appointment of a museum director
The sale of a famous painting
The renovation of a museum building
questions.explanation: 기사는 Fennimore 미술관의 여름 특별전이 사상 최다인 31만 2천 명의 관람객을 모은 성공과 그 파급 효과를 다루고 있습니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a result of the exhibition?
options: Increased museum shop sales
A rise in memberships
Busier local restaurants
Higher hotel occupancy
questions.explanation: 전시 효과로 기념품점 매출 3배 증가(A), 회원 4,800명 증가(B), 인근 식당의 주말 손님 증가(C)가 언급되었습니다. 호텔 점유율(D)은 본문에 없으므로 정답입니다.

questions.question: The word "gamble" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
options: game
risk
donation
celebration
questions.explanation: 사상 최대인 110만 달러의 마케팅 지출을 'a gamble'이라고 표현한 것은 일부 이사진이 의문을 제기할 만큼 '모험, 위험을 감수한 결정'이었다는 의미입니다. 따라서 (B) risk가 가장 가깝습니다.

questions.question: What will happen in November?
options: A textile art exhibition will open.
The museum will close for renovations.
Tickets for the next exhibition will become available.
A television campaign will begin.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 차기 대형 전시(현대 섬유 예술전)는 2월에 개막하고, 시간 지정 입장권은 11월에 판매를 시작한다('timed-entry tickets will go on sale in November')고 했습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 전시 개막은 2월이므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

passage: AUCTION WIRE — A landscape painting found during the cleanout of a farmhouse attic sold for $2.7 million at Beltrane & Co.'s spring auction on Saturday, more than nine times its high estimate. [1] The work, an 1882 river scene by the long-overlooked painter Edwin Maren, attracted eleven bidders, including three museums and several private collectors bidding by telephone. [2] The result continues a remarkable two-year rise in prices for Maren's work, which specialists attribute to a major retrospective at the Holloway Gallery that introduced the artist to a new generation of buyers. Before the retrospective, his paintings rarely brought more than $80,000. [3] Auction house director Felix Navarro said the sale demonstrates how scholarship can reshape the market. "When an artist's story is told well, collectors listen," he said. The painting's seller, who inherited the farmhouse from a great-aunt, has asked to remain anonymous. [4] Beltrane & Co. announced that its next sale of nineteenth-century art will be held on October 3 and is already accepting consignments.

questions.question: What happened at Saturday's auction?
options: A painting sold far above its estimate.
A sculpture failed to attract bidders.
A museum withdrew its collection.
An auction was postponed.
questions.explanation: 농가 다락방에서 발견된 풍경화가 최고 추정가의 9배가 넘는 270만 달러에 낙찰되었습니다('more than nine times its high estimate'). 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the article, what caused prices for Maren's work to rise?
options: The artist's recent death
A documentary film
A retrospective exhibition
A shortage of landscape paintings
questions.explanation: 전문가들은 Maren 작품 가격의 2년간 상승을 Holloway Gallery에서 열린 대규모 회고전('a major retrospective')이 새로운 세대의 구매자들에게 화가를 소개한 덕분으로 봅니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the painting's seller?
options: She is a professional art dealer.
The seller's identity has not been made public.
The seller purchased the work at a gallery.
The seller plans to donate the proceeds.

passage: COMMERCE TODAY — As online shoppers grow accustomed to same-day delivery, retailers are quietly transforming the spaces where orders are packed. Rather than relying solely on giant warehouses outside city limits, a growing number of companies are opening micro-fulfillment centers — compact, highly automated facilities tucked into urban neighborhoods. Grocery chain Fairmont Market opened its third such center last month in a former parking garage near downtown Esterville. The 2,800-square-meter site uses robotic shuttles to retrieve items from dense storage racks, allowing staff to assemble a typical fifty-item grocery order in under seven minutes. Because the center sits within five kilometers of most customers, delivery vans complete three times as many drop-offs per shift as they did from the company's suburban warehouse. Fairmont secured the location at a favorable rent, as demand for downtown parking has weakened in recent years. Real estate analysts say similar conversions are under consideration in at least a dozen cities, though some logistics experts caution that the model only pays off in densely populated areas with high order volumes.

questions.question: What trend does the article describe?
options: The decline of online grocery shopping
The use of small urban facilities to fill orders
The growth of suburban shopping malls
A shortage of delivery drivers
questions.explanation: 기사는 소매업체들이 교외의 대형 창고 대신 도심 곳곳에 소형 자동화 시설인 마이크로 풀필먼트 센터를 여는 추세를 다룹니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 온라인 장보기는 오히려 성장 배경이므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

A parking garage

protected

tightened
questions.explanation: 'Fairmont secured the location at a favorable rent'에서 secure는 유리한 임대료로 부지를 '확보하다, 얻다'라는 의미입니다. 따라서 (C) obtained가 가장 가깝습니다. lock(잠그다), protect(보호하다), tighten(조이다)은 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question: What do some experts say about micro-fulfillment centers?
options: They are profitable only in densely populated areas.
They will replace delivery vans entirely.

They are banned in most downtown districts.

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Parcelo Logistics announced today a six-month pilot program that will deploy twenty sidewalk delivery robots in the university district of Coleharbor. Beginning July 1, the knee-high, six-wheeled units will carry packages weighing up to ten kilograms from Parcelo's Brightwell Street depot to homes and businesses within a two-kilometer radius. Customers will receive a text message when a robot arrives and can unlock its cargo lid with a one-time code. The robots travel at walking speed, yield to pedestrians, and are monitored remotely by trained operators who can take control at any time. Parcelo developed the program in consultation with the Coleharbor city council, which approved the pilot in April with conditions, including a requirement that the robots stay off streets and bicycle lanes. The company estimates that robots could eventually handle 30 percent of its short-distance deliveries in the district, freeing its vans for longer routes. Residents can submit questions or report concerns through the city's mobile app. Results of the pilot will be presented at a public council meeting in January.

To announce a trial of delivery robots
To advertise a new mobile phone
To report a change in shipping rates

passage: INDUSTRY OBSERVER — At Belmar Precision Components, a sixty-employee machine shop in Garrett Falls, the newest member of the assembly team has one arm and never takes a break. The collaborative robot, or "cobot," loads metal blanks into a milling machine and inspects finished parts with a camera, tasks that previously occupied two workers for entire shifts. Contrary to early fears, no jobs were cut. The displaced workers were retrained to program and maintain the equipment, and both received pay raises. Belmar's experience reflects a wider pattern among small manufacturers, according to a survey of 300 firms released by the Mercer Institute last week. Companies that introduced cobots reported a median productivity gain of 22 percent, and four out of five said overall employment stayed level or grew within two years of adoption. Researchers caution that the transition demands careful planning: firms that skipped employee training reported far weaker results. Cobot prices have fallen by nearly half over the past six years, putting the machines within reach of shops that once considered automation an option only for large corporations.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: Safety problems caused by factory robots
The adoption of collaborative robots by small manufacturers
A strike at a machine shop
Falling demand for metal parts
questions.explanation: 기사는 소규모 제조업체 Belmar의 협동 로봇(cobot) 도입 사례와 300개 기업 설문조사를 통해 소규모 제조사들의 협동 로봇 도입 추세를 다룹니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

options: They were transferred to another city.

questions.question: The word "level" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to

unchanged
horizontal

questions.explanation: 'employment stayed level or grew'에서 level은 고용 규모가 '변동 없이 그대로 유지되었다'는 의미입니다. 따라서 (B) unchanged가 가장 가깝습니다. flat과 horizontal은 물리적 평평함을, fair는 공정함을 뜻하므로 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

options: Those that did not train their employees

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Quenton Appliance Works will invest $58 million to modernize its flagship plant in Marbury, the company announced Thursday, in the largest single upgrade since the facility opened in 1987. [1] The two-year project will install automated welding cells, a fleet of self-guided carts to move materials between stations, and a new quality-control line that uses high-resolution cameras to detect defects invisible to the human eye. [2] Production will continue throughout the renovation, with upgrades carried out section by section to avoid interrupting customer orders. The company expects the modernization to raise the plant's output by 35 percent and reduce energy use per unit by a fifth. [3] Plant manager Rosa Delgado emphasized that the workforce of 740 will not shrink. "We are growing our order book faster than our machines can keep up," she said. "This investment is about meeting demand, not cutting jobs." Quenton will also partner with Marbury Technical College to create a certificate course in automated systems maintenance, with the first class of thirty students starting in September. [4]

Upgrade a manufacturing facility

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Graduates will be guaranteed an interview for technician openings at the plant."

passage: AVIATION BRIEF — Cardinal Air, the regional carrier based at Witfield Municipal Airport, will add nonstop service to three smaller cities this fall, the airline announced at a press conference Wednesday. Beginning October 6, the carrier will fly twice daily to Brassard and Olen Springs and four times weekly to Tannerville, using 76-seat regional jets. The expansion follows a state program that offers airlines two years of reduced landing fees for serving communities that lost air service during the industry's recent contraction. Tannerville, a city of 60,000, has had no scheduled flights since its previous carrier withdrew three years ago; residents currently drive more than two hours to reach the nearest airport. Local officials predict the restored service will help the city attract a planned medical equipment plant whose executives cited poor air access as their chief hesitation. Cardinal Air's chief executive, Martin Oyelaran, said advance bookings for the Tannerville route have already exceeded projections. The airline will hire forty additional employees, including pilots, gate agents, and mechanics, to support the new schedule.

options: A merger with a national airline
New routes to three cities
An increase in baggage fees
The purchase of larger aircraft

Lower fuel prices

passage: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Meridiana Regional Airways today announced an order for eight new-generation turboprop aircraft, with options for six more, as part of a fleet renewal plan valued at $310 million. The 70-seat aircraft burn approximately 40 percent less fuel per seat than the twenty-year-old jets they will replace, and their shorter runway requirements will allow the airline to serve mountain and island airports that larger aircraft cannot reach. Deliveries will begin next June and continue through the following year. The airline will retire its oldest jets gradually as the new aircraft enter service, retraining affected flight crews at its academy in Port Saviano at no cost to employees. "Turboprops have an outdated reputation, but the economics are undeniable on routes under 600 kilometers," said fleet director Anika Sorensen. "They will let us fly to places we have had to say no to for a decade." The carrier expects the new fleet to support at least five route launches, which will be announced once delivery schedules are confirmed. Meridiana currently serves twenty-six destinations across the Corvell Archipelago and adjacent mainland.

options: An aircraft purchase
An airline merger
A new frequent-flyer program
The opening of a flight academy

questions.explanation: Priya Raman의 첫 메시지 'our 6:00 P.M. live broadcast of City Pulse needs a final check'에서 알 수 있듯이, 이 대화는 오후 6시 생방송을 앞두고 스튜디오 점검, 게스트 확인, 진행 순서 조정 등 최종 준비를 하기 위한 것입니다. (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Bell mention?

A piece of equipment is making a noise.
A playback system has crashed.
A rundown sheet is missing.

questions.question: At 4:15 P.M., what does Ms. Raman most likely mean when she writes, "That's cutting it close"?

The guest's arrival time leaves little margin before the broadcast.
The studio repair must be finished quickly.
The show's running time has been shortened.

questions.question: What is suggested about the program's revised schedule?
options: It will begin with a call-in segment.
It will be shortened by twenty minutes.
It will feature two live guests.
It will air from a different studio.

passage:
Erik Lund [6:12 A.M.]: Morning, all. Overnight inspection flagged a worn haul rope pulley on the Summit Express lift. We can't open it until the part is replaced.

She thinks the lift should remain open.
It is too dangerous to begin the repair immediately.
The forecast is probably inaccurate.

questions.question: What time is the Summit Express lift expected to reopen?

At 1:30 P.M.
At 6:30 P.M.

questions.question: What will today's lift ticket buyers receive?

questions.question: What does Ms. Idris indicate about the stockroom?

Its current tasks can be postponed briefly.

questions.question: What will be served to Renee instead of the almond torte?

A mushroom risotto
A lemon panna cotta
A fruit sorbet

questions.question: At 10:03 A.M., what does Ms. Lim most likely mean when she writes, "The permits finally cleared"?

questions.question: What must happen before trenching can begin?

questions.question: What is indicated about the Brookfield library site?

It will receive ten fast-charging units.
Concerns exist about the loss of parking spaces.
Construction there will begin on Wednesday.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Anand ask Ms. Lim to place an order right away?

The parts require a lengthy delivery period.
The project budget expires at the end of the month.
The current cables failed an inspection.

passage: HARTWELL (June 3) — The craft brewery sector in the Lakeland region continues to defy expectations. According to a report released Monday by the Regional Beverage Association, the number of independent breweries operating in the region has grown from 14 in 2020 to 41 this year, with combined annual revenue surpassing $86 million. — [1] —. Industry analysts attribute the surge to changing consumer tastes, particularly among younger adults who favor locally produced goods over national brands. — [2] —. Tourism has also played a significant role. The association estimates that brewery tours and tasting rooms attracted more than 200,000 visitors last year, many of whom traveled from outside the region. — [3] —. Not everyone is optimistic, however. Marcus Feld, an economist at Hartwell University, cautions that the market may be approaching saturation. "When growth is this rapid, smaller operations with thin margins are usually the first to struggle," he said. — [4] —. The association plans to address these concerns at its annual conference in September, where sessions will cover distribution partnerships, cost control, and export opportunities for regional brewers.

To report on the growth of a local industry
To promote an upcoming tasting event
To compare national and regional beer prices
questions.explanation: 기사 전반에 걸쳐 Lakeland 지역 수제 맥주 산업의 성장(양조장 수 14곳에서 41곳으로 증가, 연 매출 8,600만 달러 돌파)을 보도하고 있습니다. 특정 양조장 개업 소식(A), 시음 행사 홍보(C), 가격 비교(D)는 언급되지 않았으므로 (B) '지역 산업의 성장을 보도하기 위해'가 정답입니다.

passage: MERIDIAN CITY (May 18) — Residents of three Meridian City neighborhoods will soon see small aircraft buzzing overhead as part of a six-month drone delivery pilot program approved by the city council last week. Under the program, logistics firm SkyParcel will operate up to 40 deliveries per day, carrying packages weighing less than two kilograms from a distribution hub in the Fairview industrial park to designated drop-off points in Elmwood, Castor Heights, and Riverbend. Deliveries will be limited to daylight hours, and drones will follow fixed corridors that avoid schools and hospitals. SkyParcel's regional director, Anita Rao, said the company chose Meridian City because of its relatively flat terrain and supportive municipal leadership. "Our goal is to prove that drone delivery can be quiet, safe, and genuinely useful for everyday items like medications and small groceries," Rao explained. The pilot has drawn mixed reactions. A survey conducted by the city in April found that 58 percent of respondents supported the trial, while 27 percent expressed concerns about noise and privacy. City officials emphasized that the program includes a public feedback portal, and that monthly reports on safety incidents and noise complaints will be published on the city's website. If the trial is deemed successful, the council may expand the service citywide as early as next spring.

questions.question: What is the article mainly about?
options: A new airport under construction in Meridian City
A trial program for delivering packages by drone
A merger between two logistics companies
A change in regulations for commercial pilots
questions.explanation: 기사는 Meridian City 시의회가 승인한 6개월간의 드론 배송 시범 프로그램(drone delivery pilot program)에 대해 다루고 있습니다. 공항 건설(A), 물류 회사 합병(C), 조종사 규정 변경(D)은 언급되지 않았으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

They will include items weighing up to five kilograms.

questions.question: The word "deemed" in the last sentence is closest in meaning to

scheduled
awarded

passage: GLENFORD (April 9) — The Glenford City Council voted 6–1 on Tuesday to increase annual funding for the municipal library system by $1.4 million, ending months of debate over the institution's future. The additional money will restore Sunday hours at all four branches, fund the replacement of the library's twenty-year-old catalog software, and allow the hiring of three full-time youth services librarians. Library director Pauline Ostrowski called the vote "a turning point." Circulation figures, she noted, have risen 22 percent over the past three years, driven largely by demand for digital audiobooks and the library's free job-skills workshops. "People sometimes assume libraries are fading institutions," Ostrowski said. "Our numbers tell a very different story." The funding increase will be financed partly through a modest rise in commercial property fees and partly through a state grant that Glenford secured in February. Councilmember Dale Verity, who cast the lone dissenting vote, argued that the money would be better spent on road maintenance, but he acknowledged that public comment ran heavily in the library's favor. More than 300 residents submitted written statements supporting the increase, and a petition organized by the Friends of the Glenford Library gathered over 4,000 signatures. The new budget takes effect on July 1.

From Closet to Cash: The Second-Hand Boom

Once associated mainly with charity shops and bargain hunters, the second-hand fashion market has become one of retail's fastest-growing segments. — [1] —. HearthShare Opens Region's Largest Shared Commercial Kitchen

DELMONT (March 2) — HearthShare Inc. today announced the opening of its newest facility, a 2,300-square-meter shared commercial kitchen in the former Delmont Cannery building. The facility, the largest of its kind in the region, offers 28 fully equipped cooking stations that food entrepreneurs can rent by the hour, along with cold storage, packaging areas, and a loading dock for delivery vehicles. "Starting a food business traditionally requires an enormous upfront investment in equipment and licensed space," said HearthShare founder and CEO Naomi Okafor. "Our members pay only for the hours they use, which lets them test recipes, fulfill catering orders, and grow at their own pace." Membership plans start at $260 per month and include access to scheduling software, shared dry storage, and monthly business seminars led by industry mentors. The Delmont facility is HearthShare's fourth location and its first outside a major metropolitan area. The company says more than 60 food businesses—including bakers, sauce makers, and meal-kit preparers—have already reserved time at the site. Local officials welcomed the opening, noting that the cannery building had stood vacant for nearly a decade. Prospective members can tour the facility on weekdays or visit www.hearthshare.com for details.

passage: KESTREL COUNTY (February 12) — Crews began laying fiber-optic cable along Route 9 this week, marking the start of a three-year effort to bring high-speed Internet to some 18,000 rural households in Kestrel County. The $42 million project is funded jointly by the state's Digital Access Fund and Calloway Communications, the private firm selected to build and operate the network. For residents like dairy farmer Ellen Brandt, the upgrade cannot come soon enough. "I manage feed orders, veterinary records, and milk pricing online," Brandt said. "Right now I drive twenty minutes to the library parking lot just to upload files." County administrator Victor Salinas said reliable connectivity has become essential infrastructure, comparable to roads and water lines. He pointed to a county survey in which 31 percent of rural respondents reported that poor Internet service had affected their ability to work from home, and 24 percent said it complicated their children's schoolwork. Under the agreement, Calloway must offer a basic service tier at $45 per month and complete connections to all participating households by the end of 2028. The company will also open two customer service centers in the county, creating an estimated 35 jobs. Construction schedules and progress maps will be posted on the county's Web site and updated monthly.

New Packaging Rules Set to Reshape Retail Shelves

CAPITAL REPORT (January 20) — Manufacturers and retailers across the country are preparing for the Packaging Reduction Act, a sweeping set of regulations that takes effect on October 1. — [1] —. Under the law, companies that sell more than $5 million in consumer goods annually must cut single-use plastic packaging by 30 percent within five years and ensure that all remaining packaging is recyclable or compostable by 2032. — [2] —. Firms that miss the targets will face fees of up to two cents per noncompliant package, with revenue directed to municipal recycling programs. Reaction from industry has been divided. The National Grocers Alliance warned that compliance costs could raise prices on some packaged foods, while beverage maker Clearbrook Springs publicly endorsed the law, noting that it switched to fully recyclable bottles two years ago. — [3] —. Environmental groups, meanwhile, argue the timeline is too generous. "Five years is a long runway for an industry that has had decades of warning," said Mira Castellanos of the Coastal Watch Coalition. — [4] —. The Commerce Department will publish detailed compliance guidelines in March, and companies may apply for a one-year extension if they can demonstrate that suitable packaging alternatives are not commercially available.

After Dark, Business Booms at Riverside Night Market

SANTOVIA (August 30) — When the Riverside Night Market opened two summers ago with just 25 stalls, few predicted it would become one of Santovia's strongest economic engines. Today the market hosts 110 vendors every Friday and Saturday evening from May through October, drawing an average of 9,000 visitors per night, according to figures released by the Santovia Commerce Bureau this week. The bureau estimates that the market generated $7.8 million in direct sales last season and supported roughly 460 part-time jobs. Its effects reach beyond the riverfront: nearby restaurants, parking facilities, and rideshare drivers all report higher weekend earnings since the market opened. For many vendors, the market serves as a low-cost testing ground. Stall fees start at $70 per night, far below the rent for a permanent storefront. At least 14 businesses that began as night market stalls have since opened brick-and-mortar locations in the city, including the popular dumpling shop Lantern & Ladle. Not all feedback has been positive. Some residents of the adjacent Harborview district have complained about late-night noise and limited parking. In response, the city has added two shuttle routes and moved the market's closing time from midnight to 11:00 P.M. Bureau director Camille Renaud says applications for next season's stalls have already doubled compared with last year.

passage: BRENVILLE (July 14) — The Brenville Transit Authority (BTA) marked a milestone on Friday as the last of its 120 diesel buses was retired, completing a five-year transition to an entirely electric fleet. PORT ELLISON (October 5) — For decades, the Marlowe House stood as a reminder of Port Ellison's golden age of rail travel—and, more recently, of its decline. This week, the 1912 building reopened as the Marlowe House Hotel, a 38-room boutique property that its owners hope will anchor the city's reviving waterfront district. Hotelier Grace Yun purchased the derelict property three years ago and invested $9.6 million in its renovation. Rather than modernizing the building beyond recognition, Yun's team preserved its defining features: the marble lobby staircase, the original brass elevator doors, and the hand-painted ceiling of the former ballroom, which now serves as the hotel's restaurant. "Guests today are tired of hotels that look identical in every city," Yun said. "They want a place with a story, and this building has a century of them." Period photographs sourced from the Port Ellison Historical Society line the corridors, and each guest room is named after a historic local figure. The renovation also added contemporary comforts, including soundproof windows, a fitness studio, and a rooftop terrace overlooking the harbor. Room rates begin at $240 per night, and the hotel reports that it is fully booked through November. Two more historic buildings on Wharf Street are reportedly being considered for similar conversions.

Behind the Label: How Resale Platforms Verify Luxury Goods

In the booming second-hand luxury market, trust is the most valuable commodity. As online platforms handle growing volumes of pre-owned designer handbags, watches, and apparel, the industry has invested heavily in authentication—the process of confirming that an item is genuine. At Verity Lane, one of the largest resale platforms, every luxury item passes through a regional verification center before reaching a buyer. There, trained specialists examine stitching patterns, hardware engravings, date codes, and even the smell of leather, which counterfeit tanning processes often fail to replicate. Items priced above $2,000 undergo a second review by a senior authenticator. The company says its specialists complete a six-month training program and must pass quarterly assessments to keep their certification current. Technology is playing a growing part as well. Verity Lane recently introduced a microscope-camera system that captures magnified images of an item's surface texture and compares them against a database of verified originals. According to chief operations officer Felix Marchetti, the system has cut average inspection time from 40 minutes to 25 while improving accuracy. "Counterfeits keep getting better, so our methods have to evolve faster," Marchetti said. The investment appears to pay off: the platform reports that fewer than 0.3 percent of items sold last year were returned over authenticity disputes, an industry-leading figure.

Dear Mr. Okafor,

Thank you for serving as a volunteer floor warden during the fire drill held at Marsh Tower on 22 May. This letter summarizes the observations recorded by our team and the actions we ask you to share with staff on the fourth floor.

Overall, the evacuation was completed in seven minutes and twenty seconds, well within the building target. However, two issues require attention. First, several employees on your floor carried laptop bags down the stairwell, slowing movement at the landing between the third and fourth floors. Please remind staff that belongings must be left behind. Second, the fire door beside the east kitchenette was propped open with a chair. Propped fire doors are a serious code violation, and the chair has been removed.

We ask that you review these points at your next floor meeting and confirm by 6 June that the briefing has taken place. A refresher session for all wardens will be offered online in early July; an invitation will follow separately.

Thank you again for your commitment to workplace safety.

Sincerely,
Leona Vasquez
Safety Compliance Officer, Marsh Tower Management

INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING THE EXPORT DECLARATION — FORM CD-7
Issued by Calverton Freight Services for business customers

All international shipments valued above $250 must be accompanied by a completed Form CD-7. Follow the steps below to avoid customs delays.

Step 1: In Section A, enter the full legal name and address of both the exporter and the recipient. Post-office boxes are not accepted for the recipient field.

Step 2: In Section B, describe each item in plain language. Vague terms such as 'parts' or 'samples' will be rejected by customs officers. Include the quantity, unit value, and country of manufacture for every line.

Step 3: In Section C, enter the six-digit tariff classification code. If you do not know the code, leave the field as (blank) and our brokerage team will complete it for a $12 service fee per shipment.

Step 4: Sign and date Section D. Unsigned forms are returned to the sender, and the shipment is held at our depot for up to five business days before being sent back.

Completed forms may be submitted online or handed to the driver at pickup. For assistance, call our customs help line at 555-0142, weekdays 8 A.M. to 6 P.M.

GUEST NOTICE — RENOVATION OF THE BAYVIEW WING
The Aldermere Hotel

We are pleased to announce a full renovation of our Bayview Wing, to be carried out in two phases so that the hotel can remain open throughout.

Phase One (5 January to 28 February): Floors six through eight of the Bayview Wing will be closed. Guests who previously reserved rooms on these floors have been moved, at no extra cost, to equivalent rooms in the Garden Wing and were notified by e-mail in December.

Phase Two (1 March to 30 April): Floors three through five will close, and the renovated upper floors will reopen with updated bathrooms, soundproof windows, and new climate controls.

As an apology for any inconvenience, all guests staying during the renovation will receive a 15 percent discount on dining at our Marina Restaurant. We thank you for your patience as we improve your future stays.

FROM: Payroll Department, Veltrane Industries
SUBJECT: Change to the Payroll Calendar

Starting in October, Veltrane Industries will move from a twice-monthly pay schedule (the 15th and the last day of each month) to a biweekly schedule, with payments issued every other Friday. The first biweekly payday will be Friday, 9 October.

Why the change? Under the new system, paydays will always fall on the same weekday, making personal budgeting easier, and overtime will be calculated over a standard two-week period rather than being split across pay cycles.

What you will notice: Because biweekly pay produces 26 payments per year instead of 24, each individual paycheck will be slightly smaller, although your annual salary is unchanged. Twice a year there will be a month containing three paydays.

Action required: Employees who have set automatic transfers timed to the 15th and month-end should adjust them before October. Direct-deposit banking details do not need to be re-entered; they carry over automatically.

A calculator showing your new per-paycheck amount is available on the payroll page of the intranet. Questions may be submitted to payroll@veltrane.com by 25 September and will be answered in a follow-up bulletin.

Effective Monday, 3 August

The City of Fairhaven Parking Authority is revising rates at the Orchard Street Garage for the first time in six years. The changes reflect increased maintenance costs and fund the new license-plate recognition system, which eliminates paper tickets.

- First hour: $3.00 (previously $2.50)

--- Passage 3 ---
To: accounts@citywheel.com
From: Lena Voss, Finance Manager, Greenfield Consulting
Subject: Question about May charges
Hello,
Our May invoice lists $61.50 in charges beyond our monthly plan fee, and I would like to confirm how this amount was calculated before approving payment. Also, our riders are using e-bikes more each month, and several employees have asked for longer ride allowances. Could you tell me whether moving to your larger plan would remove either of these extra costs? If the numbers make sense, we would like any change to start at the beginning of July.
Regards,
Lena Voss

questions.question: What is one feature included in both corporate plans?
options: Unlimited ride time
Monthly usage reports
Free e-bike unlock fees
Up to 100 registered riders
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 두 플랜 모두 월간 사용 보고서와 전담 계정 관리자가 포함된다고 명시되어 있습니다. e-bike 잠금 해제 수수료 면제와 100명 등록은 Business Plan에만 해당하며, 무제한 이용 시간은 어느 플랜에도 없습니다.

questions.question: How was the $61.50 in additional charges most likely calculated?
options: 310 rides multiplied by a service fee
210 excess minutes at $0.15 plus 30 e-bike unlocks at $1.00
A late payment penalty added to the plan fee
22 riders multiplied by a registration charge
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 1의 Team Plan 요율에 따르면 초과 시간은 분당 $0.15, e-bike 잠금 해제는 회당 $1.00입니다. 지문 2에서 초과 시간 합계는 210분, e-bike 잠금 해제는 30회이므로 210 x $0.15 = $31.50, 30 x $1.00 = $30.00, 합계 $61.50입니다.

questions.question: If Greenfield Consulting upgrades to the Business Plan, which May charge would have been completely eliminated?
options: The monthly plan fee
The e-bike unlock fees
All excess-minute charges
The account manager fee
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 Business Plan은 e-bike 잠금 해제 수수료가 전액 면제되므로 지문 2의 $30 상당 수수료는 사라집니다. 반면 포함 시간은 60분으로 늘어날 뿐이므로 60분을 넘는 초과 요금 가능성은 남아 있어 '모든' 초과 요금이 없어진다고 단정할 수 없습니다. 월 기본료는 오히려 $900로 올라갑니다.

questions.question: In the e-mail, what does Ms. Voss ask the company to do?
options: Refund the May invoice in full
Explain how the additional charges were calculated
Register more riders under the current plan
Repair several damaged e-bikes
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 Voss 씨는 결제를 승인하기 전에 $61.50가 어떻게 산정되었는지 확인하고 싶다고 요청했습니다. 환불 요구나 라이더 추가 등록, 자전거 수리는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the webpage, when would Greenfield's requested plan change take effect?
options: Immediately upon request
On July 1
At the end of the billing year
On the date the account manager approves it
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 플랜 변경은 다음 달 1일부터 적용된다고 했고, 지문 3에서 Voss 씨는 7월 초부터 변경을 원한다고 했습니다. 6월 중 요청하면 규정에 따라 7월 1일부터 적용되므로 그녀의 희망 시점과 일치합니다.

passage:

Project Brief — LinguaBridge Order #TR-2284
Client: Meridian Legal Partners | Contact: Owen Castillo

questions.question: What was the original quoted price for Order #TR-2284?
questions.explanation: 연계 계산 문제입니다. 지문 2에서 8,000단어의 법률(legal) 문서이며 공증 번역이 필요합니다. 지문 1의 요율로 계산하면 단어당 $0.10 + 법률 할증 $0.04 = $0.14이므로 8,000 x $0.14 = $1,120이고, 공증 번역 $35를 더하면 총 $1,155입니다. $800은 표준 요율만 적용한 금액입니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Duarte request a deadline extension?
options: She received the source document late
Verifying specialized legal terminology is taking extra time
The client increased the word count of the contract
She was assigned to another urgent project
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 Duarte 씨는 관할권별 법률 용어가 매우 많아 각 용어를 현행 스페인어 법률 용례와 대조하는 작업이 예상보다 오래 걸린다고 설명했습니다. 문서 수령 지연, 분량 증가, 다른 프로젝트 배정은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: If Mr. Castillo accepts the offer in the e-mail, how much will his company most likely pay?
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 원래 견적은 $1,155(지문 1의 요율 + 지문 2의 사양)이고, 지문 3에서 마감 연장의 보상으로 총액에 10% 할인을 제안했습니다. $1,155 x 0.90 = $1,039.50입니다. $1,008은 공증료를 빼고 계산한 함정 답안입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the certification statement?
options: It will still be provided as originally planned
It will be omitted because of the delay
It requires an additional rush fee
It must be signed by Mr. Castillo
questions.explanation: 지문 3에서 'The certification statement will be included as planned'라고 명시하여, 마감 연장과 무관하게 공증 진술서는 예정대로 포함된다고 확인했습니다. 생략되거나 추가 비용이 발생한다는 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: What is the proposed new deadline for the project?
options: Friday, May 9
Saturday, May 10
Sunday, May 11
Monday, May 12
questions.explanation: 지문 2의 원래 마감일은 5월 9일 금요일이고, 지문 3에서 Duarte 씨는 이틀 연장하여 5월 11일 일요일로 마감을 변경해 달라고 요청했습니다.

passage:
Skyline Terrace — Venue Rules for Private Events
Maximum rooftop capacity: 120 guests. All events must conclude by 10:00 P.M., and amplified music must end by 9:00 P.M. Open flames of any kind, including candles, are strictly prohibited under city fire code. In case of bad weather, the indoor Garden Lounge (capacity: 60 guests) may be added to a booking for an additional $400. Cancellations made within seven days of an event forfeit the full deposit.

--- Passage 2 ---
Event Proposal — Skyline Terrace
Organization: Halcyon Tech | Event: Summer Staff Party | Date: Friday, July 17
Expected attendance: 95 guests | Time: 5:00 P.M. - 9:30 P.M.
Entertainment: Live band, 6:00 P.M. - 9:00 P.M.
Decor plan: String lights and lit candles on all tables
Catering: External caterer (Verde Kitchen), buffet service

--- Passage 3 ---
To: events@halcyontech.com
From: m.ferraro@skylineterrace.com
Subject: July 17 — weather plan and decor note
Dear Halcyon Tech events team,
The extended forecast now shows a 70% chance of rain on July 17. We can add our indoor backup space to your booking at the standard supplement, but please be aware that it cannot accommodate your full guest list, so you may need to reduce attendance or split the group into two seatings. Separately, our review of your proposal flagged your table decor plan, which conflicts with our safety rules. Battery-powered LED candles are permitted and look quite similar — most clients are happy with them. Please confirm your decisions by July 10 so we can finalize arrangements.
Regards,
Marco Ferraro, Events Manager

questions.question: According to the venue rules, by what time must amplified music end?
questions.explanation: 지문 1에서 모든 행사는 오후 10시까지 종료해야 하고, 증폭 음악(amplified music)은 오후 9시까지 끝나야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 지문 2의 라이브 밴드가 9시에 끝나는 일정은 이 규정에 부합합니다.

questions.question: Why might the indoor backup space be a problem for Halcyon Tech?
options: It is unavailable on July 17
Its capacity is smaller than the expected attendance
It does not allow external caterers
It costs more than the rooftop rental
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 실내 Garden Lounge의 수용 인원은 60명인데, 지문 2에서 예상 참석자는 95명입니다. 지문 3에서도 전체 인원을 수용할 수 없어 인원 축소나 2회 분산이 필요할 수 있다고 안내합니다. 따라서 수용 인원 부족이 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much would adding the indoor space cost Halcyon Tech?
options: It would be free of charge
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 3에서 Ferraro 씨는 'standard supplement(표준 추가 요금)'로 실내 공간을 추가할 수 있다고 했고, 지문 1에서 그 금액은 $400로 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.question: What part of Halcyon Tech's proposal conflicts with the venue's rules?
options: The use of an external caterer
The lit candles planned for the tables
The number of hours booked for the band
The 5:00 P.M. start time
questions.explanation: 연계 문제입니다. 지문 1에서 양초를 포함한 모든 화기(open flames)는 소방 규정상 금지된다고 했는데, 지문 2의 장식 계획에는 테이블마다 불을 붙인 양초(lit candles)가 포함되어 있습니다. 지문 3에서도 장식 계획이 안전 규정과 충돌한다며 LED 양초를 제안합니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Ferraro ask the Halcyon Tech team to do?
options: Confirm their decisions by July 10
Pay their deposit within seven days
Change the event to a different venue
Hire a different catering company
questions.explanation: 지문 3의 마지막 문장에서 'Please confirm your decisions by July 10'이라고 요청했습니다. 보증금 납부, 장소 변경, 케이터링 업체 교체는 요청 사항이 아닙니다.
